rows.title: Founding Growth Marketer
rows.descriptionText:
⚠️ Please read first

This is a full-time, in-person role based in San Francisco (Presidio) - we work from the office 5 days a week. You must be based in the Bay Area or willing to relocate before starting. We require US work authorization , but are open to O-1 or J-1 visa sponsorship for exceptional candidates. 

About Sauna By Wordware

Every tool you use was built as an island, so you became the glue between them. You carry a name from Gmail into the CRM, a time from the CRM into Calendly, a note from Calendly into a doc. AI showed up and mostly became an eleventh window to paste into.

Sauna is a hybrid of AI and software standing on one shared brain. It holds your context and hands you real software built on top of it. You talk to it like a chatbot and use what it builds like an app: software for the path you repeat, AI for the edge that never repeats. Keep it to yourself, or share the brain with your team.

The clearest way to see it is a tool doing what its whole category cannot. An ordinary Calendly shows a stranger your free slots. Your Calendly writes the invite email itself, because it knows how the two of you know each other, and it offers a board member the slot over your gym block, because it knows which of your busy hours bend and for whom.

Wordware is the team behind it, 15 people backed by Spark Capital, Felicis, and Y Combinator with a $30M seed, the largest in YC's history. We build from an office in the Presidio, fifty metres from Crissy Field beach, and we work absurdly hard because we can see and feel the outcome every day.

About The Role

Here is the honest state of things.

People who try Sauna stay. Our week-two retention is 74%, which is the number investors care most about and the one we are proud of. Almost nobody knows the product exists. We have done no paid, no SEO, no affiliate, no referral loops, and nothing on lifecycle. Our top of funnel is a founder sending a hundred cold emails a day from his own inbox between product decisions.

That gap is the entire job. You will own demand: everything that takes a stranger from never having heard of Sauna to arriving and signing up. You get a real budget on day one, and you report directly to me.

Spend starts early here on purpose. Paid is the fastest way to find out whether the messaging, the creative, the positioning and the funnel actually work, and it answers in a week what content and interviews answer in a quarter. We will do the slow compounding work alongside it rather than waiting for it.

Retention and activation live with the product team. You bring quality people to the door and you own what it costs to get them there.

This is a making role before it is a managing role. For the first months you are the person writing the posts, briefing the videos, buying the media, and shipping the landing pages. Once a channel proves out, you hire against it.

The blank canvas is the appeal and the risk. There is no brand to inherit, no channel already half-working, and no historical performance data to defend. If that sounds like the best year of your career, we should talk.

Your First 30 Days

Before real money moves, the measurement has to be real. You will work with Amelia on analytics to stand up:

Conversion tracking that fires on the events that matter, server-side where it needs to be Match rate on Meta and enrichment score on Google, pushed as high as they go A fully loaded CAC that counts free trial credits as marketing spend, because they are An honest read on unit economics per channel, including inference cost, since usage is our cost of goods 

Sauna is a usage-based product with real variance in what a customer costs us. Meta and Google are not built for that. Getting the measurement right is what makes the rest of the job possible.

What You'll Do

Own the top of the funnel end to end: paid on Meta and Google first, then lifecycle, then everything that compounds around them. Run a creator program. A six-figure monthly Meta budget needs 400 to 500 fresh creatives a month to keep working. That is a program you build with creators and agencies, not a set of ads you write. Build an affiliate program and treat it as a real channel. Revenue share, a reason for people to earn before they are customers, and a public place to sign up. Build a content engine with the product itself as the subject. Use Sauna to do your own job in public, and show real work rather than talking about capabilities. Ship programmatic SEO and AEO with an engineering partner. Answer engines cite YouTube, Reddit, and credible third-party coverage, so the work runs wider than our own pages. Write the copy yourself. Landing pages, ads, emails, posts, video scripts. Run launches end to end: positioning, copy, social, email, video brief, press, community. Report one number every week: how many new people heard about Sauna and came to look, and what each one cost. 

Minimum

Who You Are:

You have run actual ads with your own hands. You picked the channel, wrote the creative, set the budget, read the numbers, and killed what was not working. You get a real budget here, so this is a floor. You understand what a conversion event is, why match rate matters, and what happens to a campaign when tracking is half broken. You have taken something from unknown to known. A product, a newsletter, a channel, a community, or your own company. You can tell me the starting number, the number a year later, and what you did in between. You are a systems thinker. You can step back from a task, map the whole system your job sits inside, and say which parts a machine should be doing. You have built something that does part of your job for you, with a feedback loop in it. Not a chat thread with context in it. A loop that gets better because you corrected it. You write unusually well. Punchy, specific, opinionated, and able to hold someone else's voice. You know what is working on X, YouTube, LinkedIn, and TikTok this month. You are technical enough to ship a landing page and brief SEO work without filing a ticket for every change. 

Bonus And Genuinely Not Required

You have priced or grown a usage-based product and know why LTV to CAC is not enough when inference is your cost of goods. You have run a UGC creator program or an affiliate program at real volume. A portfolio of work that traveled, with the numbers attached. Existing relationships with creators, newsletters, or AI community distribution channels. Already using Sauna, or something like it, as part of how you work. 

Probably Not a Fit If

You would only want to work on conversion inside a funnel that already has traffic. You need an established brand, a spend history, and a team in place before you can get moving. You would rather direct the work than make it. Your depth is one channel and you would rather stay in it. 

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $150,000 to $250,000, depending on experience and how much of the role you can own from day one + meaningful early-stage equity.

You will also have a real media budget, set with Filip.

Standard Wordware benefits: medical, dental, and vision; daily lunch and dinner in the office; 401(k); gym budget; the Presidio office with a sauna and the beach across the road.

How To Apply

Answer one question in three paragraphs or fewer:

Tell us about a system you built that does part of your job for you. What was manual before, where does a human still touch it, and what happens when it produces something bad?

We read this before anything else on your application.

The Process

We keep our process simple. Exceptional candidates go from first touch to offer within 2 weeks.

Application: Submit your resume and answer a few short questions. 15-minute intro call: Quick check to align on location, motivation, and logistics. If it's a go, we move fast from here. Growth deep-dive: Walk through a channel you owned zero-to-scale and how you would approach ours. Final conversation: We answer your questions and scope out the work trial. Work trial: Paid, in person, usually a few days to two weeks. You work on a real project with us. See how we work, see if it fits, both sides.

About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

The Global Cross Border team is responsible for defining the cross border business strategy across travel and eCommerce and managing its execution across our five regions, working closely with market teams and cross-functional leaders around the world.

Cross Border is a key pillar of Visa’s 2030 strategy and one of the largest growth opportunities for Visa. Equally, it faces many complex and interesting challenges, touching all areas of the business, including product, pricing, legal, regulation, marketing, client engagement, and partnerships.

rows.descriptionText:
Brief Description

Hybrid: Applicants must be a California resident as of their first day of employment.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Medicare Field Sales & Community Agent is responsible for compliantly achieving established monthly, quarterly, and annual Medicare Advantage (D-SNP) new enrollment and retention goals. Consistently enrolling self-generated, Partner generated, and company generated Medicaid conversion and marketing leads is essential to this role’s success. The agent must work in collaboration with their team members and other Alameda Alliance for Health (AAH) department personnel to develop and execute an effective growth and retention strategy. A key part of that strategy will require them to work effectively and leverage relationships with providers, community organizations, and other influencers. Their engagement will take the form of participation in or sponsorship of local community events, individual provider co-marketing programs, and targeted member outreach activities in conjunction with community partners.

Medicare Field Sales & Community Agent will report to the Manager, Medicare Sales and Retention. The incumbent will be assigned specific responsibilities as determined by their manager based on opportunities identified related to product offerings, geographic or other market segmentation criteria.

The agent will be expected to generate new enrollments and achieve established retention targets through consistent and thoughtful member and prospect engagement activities. The agent must consistently complete proven “best practice” based activities to develop and manage their territories and/or assignments and provide regular status reporting at predetermined intervals via the sales departments established activity and performance tracking system. The agent will be expected to comply with all CMS, DMHC, and DHCS guidelines and quickly report any potential issues to their manager or Chief Compliance Officer.

Principle responsibilities include: 

Expected to consistently meet or exceed established performance standards across the following key areas:Production: Achieve a minimum of 60 enrollments per month, which equates to an average of three (3) enrollments per working day, based on a standard 20-day work month. Monthly targets may be adjusted to account for holidays, approved time off, or business needs. Quality: Maintain a minimum 85% quality adherence score on a monthly basis as measured by internal quality review standards, including accuracy of application submissions and adherence to sales protocols. Regulatory Compliance: Demonstrating a minimum of 85% adherence to all applicable federal and state regulations including CMS Medicare Marketing Guidelines and California specific requirements per month. This includes accurate, ethical, and compliant representation of all Medicare products and services.Putting the member or prospective members needs first and assisting them in their efforts to enroll with AAH via whatever channel best meets their needs, i.e. face-to-face, online, group setting, telephonic. Responsible for professionally representing AAH Medicare D-SNP programs in the market to all members, prospects, providers, and partners. Assisting prospective members in their efforts to understand AAH’s products, services, mission, and unique value proposition. rows.title: Software Engineer, Creator
rows.descriptionText:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Software Engineer on the Creator, Experience LiveOps team, you'll work full-stack across our backend services and the creator-hub web app (TypeScript/React) to ship features that let every creator run live-ops the way large studios do: safely, and at platform scale. You'll own meaningful pieces from day one and work closely with senior and principal engineers, our PM, and design. Join us and give the entire creator community live-ops superpowers.

The Experience LiveOps (ELO) Team builds the runtime tools creators use to operate and tune their live experiences without shipping a code release. Our surfaces include Remote Configs (targeted, scheduled, and AI-assisted configuration), A/B Experimentation with real metrics and early harm detection, audience Segmentation, and Open Cloud / public APIs that expose all of it programmatically.

You Will

Build and ship features across ELO's config, experimentation, and segmentation surfaces, backend services and the creator-hub UI.Own projects end-to-end (spec to launch) with support from senior/principal engineers on the team.Partner with PM, design, DSA/Discovery, and Data Platform to deliver high-quality, well-instrumented features.Participate in code reviews, share knowledge with teammates, and take part in the team's on-call rotation.

You Are

An engineer with 1-3 years of experience building software systems (industry experience). Full-stack-comfortable: you can move between backend services and a web frontend (TypeScript/React), and you're not afraid to learn the half you know less well.A finisher: you take features from spec through launch with guidance from senior teammates, and you care that they keep working — testing, monitoring, and follow-through.Pragmatic & collaborative: you communicate clearly, ask good questions, and are low-ego about code and feedback.Curious: you stay current and like understanding why a system behaves the way it does.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.

$153,120—$196,750 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

rows.title: Wellness Center Operations Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Wellness Center Operations Coordinator

A job at TSMC Arizona offers an opportunity to work at the most advanced semiconductor fab in the United States. TSMC Arizona’s first fab will operate its leading-edge semiconductor process technology (N4 process), starting production in the first half of 2025. The second fab will utilize its leading edge N3 and N2 process technology and be operational in 2028. The recently announced third fab will manufacture chips using 2nm or even more advanced process technology, with production starting by the end of the decade. America’s leading technology companies are ready to rely on TSMC Arizona for the next generations of chips that will power the digital future.

As a Wellness Center Operations Coordinator, you will demonstrate a strong sense of reliability and enthusiasm and will possess an attitude that embodies our core values – Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for the seamless administrative and operational management of our company's on-site clinic. You will oversee daily clinic functions, financial processes, inter-departmental communications, and lead health promotion initiatives. This position requires a licensed nurse who is passionate about both healthcare administration and direct employee support.

Responsibilities

Clinic Administration & Management:Oversee and streamline daily clinic operations, ensuring efficiency and high standards of service.Manage clinic resources, including inventory, supplies, and equipment maintenance.Develop and implement clinic policies and procedures to ensure compliance with relevant health regulations.Financial Management:Handle invoice processing, reimbursement procedures, and manage the clinic's operational budget.Monitor expenditures and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality of care.Quality Assurance & Compliance:Conduct regular clinic audits (internal and external) to ensure adherence to internal protocols and external regulatory standards.Maintain accurate and confidential health records.Support the safety department and ensure compliance with relevant occupational health and safety regulations (e.g., OSHA).Cross-Departmental Communication & Collaboration:Serve as the primary liaison between the clinic and various internal departments (e.g., HR, Safety, Finance) to ensure coordinated health services and effective communication.Collaborate with external medical providers as needed.Health Promotion & Employee Engagement:Proactively design, organize, and execute innovative health promotion events and wellness programs that foster high employee participation and engagement.Provide health-related education to employees on various topics (e.g., first aid, health awareness, wellness practices).Analyze employee health trends and feedback to tailor wellness initiatives that resonate with the workforce.Develop engaging content and materials for health education initiatives, encouraging healthy lifestyle choices.Champion a culture of health and well-being within the company.Emergency Response Support:Be an integral part of the corporate Emergency Medical Services (EMS) response team, co-work with the company's emergency response center, providing support and assistance during drills and on-site medical emergencies.Ensure clinic readiness for emergency situations.Staff Oversight:Supervise the medical staff team (e.g., occupational health nurses, shift nurses) and oversee day-to-day activities.Counsel employees on medical conditions and help them access medical services.Contribute to the provision of training, advice, health surveillance, vaccinations, and other general occupational health issues.Ensure clinic staff maintain required certifications and stay updated on best practices.
Minimum Qualifications/Requirements

Education:Valid Registered Nurse (RN) licenseExperiences:Minimum of 1 years of experience in clinic administration, healthcare management, or a similar role.Proven experience in budgeting, invoicing, and financial oversight within a healthcare setting.Demonstrated experience in designing and implementing successful health promotion programs with a focus on employee participation.Familiarity with occupational health regulations and practices.Technical Skills:Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and experience with electronic health records (EHR) systems.Sound knowledge of patient documentation systems.Familiarity with US medical systems/resources in Arizona.Interpersonal Skills:Highly flexible, proactive, and customer-oriented attitude.Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with employees at all levels, external partners, and medical professionals.Strong leadership and team collaboration abilities.High degree of discretion, empathy, and patient confidentiality.Proactive problem-solver with a strong attention to detail.Ability to inspire and engage employees in health and wellness initiatives.Strong presentation and persuasive skills to advocate for health programs.Physical Requirements:Ability to respond to drills or on-site medical emergencies quickly and effectively.Ability to perform duties that may require standing, walking, and occasional lifting of light medical supplies.Training:This role requires participation in and successful completion of all company-mandated training programs.
Preferred Education

Other above-entry medical license (e.g., Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant).Bachelor’s degree in nursing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
Shift Expectation

Standard work hours: Monday through Friday 8:00am-5:00pm or 9:00am-6:00pm

Application Consideration Consent

By applying to this position, I acknowledge and agree that my application and qualifications may be considered for other roles within the company. However, I reserve the right to withdraw my consent for future consideration of other roles within the company at any time.

Candidates must be willing and able to work on-site at our Phoenix, Arizona facility.

Benefits

As a valued member of the TSMC family, we place a significant focus on your health and well-being. When you are at your best—physically, mentally, and financially—our company thrives. TSMC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits program that includes:

Medical, Dental, and Vision Plans: Choose the options that best fit your and your family’s needs.Income-Protection Programs: Financial assistance during injury or illness.401(k) Retirement Savings Plan: Secure your financial future with competitive employer contributions.Paid Time-Off Programs and Holidays: Recharge and spend quality time with loved ones.

Work Location: 5088 W. Innovation Circle, Phoenix, AZ 85083

TSMC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and welcome applications from diverse backgrounds and experiences. Candidates must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. If you need an accommodation as part of the application process, please contact P_LOA@tsmc.com .

TSMC Arizona maintains the right to change or assign other duties to this position

All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of TSMC Arizona’s pre-employment screening process. rows.title: Outreach Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
The Outreach Specialist plays a critical role on our Marketing, Outreach, & Enrollment (MOE) team. This role is the driver of enrollment success — building relationships in the community, generating quality referrals, and guiding prospective participants into the PACE program.
No “hard sell” pressure – You’re not pushing a product; you’re connecting vulnerable seniors with life-changing careMission-driven work – You’ll be helping participants get the support they need to stay in their homes and communitiesFocus on relationships, not transactions – You’ll build genuine, ongoing relationships with seniors, caregivers, and community partners rather than chasing one-off salesCommunity-first approach – You’ll engage with the community at events, local organizations, and face-to-face outreach instead of cold-calling all day
We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days401K savings + matchComprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonusAnd additional benefits!
On the day-to-day, you will:Coordinate and initiate outreach and engagement activities in communitiesIdentify opportunities to collaborate with community organizations to generate qualified leads, leading to potential enrollmentsEstablish and maintain relationships with community leaders and partners including senior centers, assisted living facilities, food banks, churches, and other community-based organizationsDevelop and implement monthly marketing plans to consistently achieve monthly enrollment metric goals with MOE DirectorProvide education regarding WelbeHealth’s services to community referral sources
Job requirements include:Bachelor’s degree in marketing or health care administration preferredDHCS training and exam as a marketing representative within 30 days of hireMinimum of one (1) year of experience in a sales and marketing role with at least one (1) year in a healthcare or senior care setting preferred (within service area preferred; outside sales experience preferred)Technology experience which can include Salesforce, Athena, etc.

Minimum 1 year of experience in a technical support role, preferably with hardware experience.
Familiarity with help desk ticketing systems and remote support tools
High School Diploma or GED

Experience with AR VR technology is a plus

rows.title: AI Operations Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
About The Company

Valerie Health is the AI front office for independent provider groups. We are reimagining how independent practices operate by using AI to modernize patient and provider communication, enhance care, and drive industry changing operational efficiencies.

Why join us now?

Team: We are led by Pete Shalek (2x health tech exits, including a $600M acquisition by Optum) and Nitin Joshi (scaled Uber Eats + Health, Stripe Connect, and Bridge, acquired by Stripe for $1.1B). Beyond our founders, our team brings DNA from category leaders (Uber, Stripe, Meta), high growth unicorns, and top consulting firms.

Trajectory: We partner with leading independent provider groups across the U.S., automating hundreds of thousands of tasks each month. Scaling at 7x year-over-year with 300% NRR as customers consistently expand usage.

Funding: We have raised $39M from world class investors including Redpoint Ventures, General Catalyst, Primary Ventures, and BoxGroup.

About The Role

Operations Specialists are the operators behind Valerie’s AI platform. Each specialist owns the operational delivery for a set of partner medical groups, ensuring their workflows run accurately, efficiently, and reliably.

You will serve as the primary operational owner (Ops POC) for assigned customers, responsible for maintaining high-quality execution while helping improve the systems and workflows that power Valerie’s platform.

For high-performing team members, this role offers meaningful growth opportunities within the first 6-12 months. As Valerie scales, strong operators often expand their scope beyond core workflow execution to drive process improvements, support automation initiatives, and help shape how operations runs across new partners and products.

Working inside a fast-growing AI-native company also provides exposure to how different parts of the business operate, including operations, engineering, and customer teams. This environment creates opportunities for strong performers to grow into new roles within Valerie over time, while developing skills that translate well across the broader startup ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Own Operational Delivery for Customers: Serve as the primary operations POC for partner practices, ensuring their workflows run smoothly and meet quality and performance expectations, including supporting the rollout and implementation of new product lines. Execute Core Platform Workflows: Process and verify patient and practice data through Valerie’s internal systems with high accuracy and speed. Maintain Quality and Data Integrity: Identify discrepancies, edge cases, and workflow issues and resolve or escalate them quickly to maintain platform reliability. Improve Operational Systems: Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve workflow efficiency, and strengthen operational processes. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Central Operations, Engineering, and Customer teams to surface issues, provide operational insights, and help improve the platform. 

About You

Experience:

Bachelor’s degree with a strong academic track record or equivalent experience with a trajectory of high achievement. Early-career candidates are encouraged to apply. Prior startup, operations, or healthcare experience is helpful but not required. Demonstrated ability to learn new systems, tools, and workflows quickly. 

Attributes:

Ownership Mindset: Takes responsibility for outcomes and treats assigned customers and workflows as their own. High Attention to Detail: Able to work quickly while maintaining extremely high accuracy. Execution Speed: Moves with urgency and follows through to completion. Problem Solver: Comfortable identifying issues, diagnosing root causes, and driving improvements. Strong Communicator: Clear written and verbal communication with teammates and cross-functional partners. Thrives in a Startup Environment: Comfortable working in ambiguity and adapting as the company grows. 

Own your impact

We hire exceptional people and hold them to a high standard. We're scaling rapidly and solving real problems for providers. You'll own your work end to end, with the autonomy to make the decisions that matter. The pace is demanding and the work is intense.

What we offer

Competitive salary, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and lunch served on in-office daysCareer trajectory: This role is a launchpad for early-career operators, with opportunities to grow into new roles as the company scalesSF office: Daily catered lunch and dinner reimbursement

Compensation Range: $65K - $85K

rows.title: FP&A Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

What You'll Do

The FP&A Analyst reports to the VP, Financial Planning & Analysis and supports the Finance team in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis across the organization. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how a capital-intensive, fast-growing infrastructure business operates and to build core FP&A skills from the ground floor of a newly formed company. You will support recurring financial processes, build and maintain models, and contribute to reporting that informs executive decision-making. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their FP&A career who wants broad exposure across corporate finance - including the capital planning that sits at the center of this business.

In This Role, You Will

Forecasting & Budgeting Support - Support the monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes by gathering inputs from business partners, maintaining templates, and ensuring timely and accurate submissionsFinancial Analysis - Perform variance analysis comparing actuals to budget and forecast; identify key drivers and prepare clear explanations for leadership reviewReporting - Assist in preparing monthly financial reports, executive summaries, and ad-hoc analyses; ensure data accuracy and consistency across deliverablesData Management - Help build and maintain the company's planning platform from the ground up, including data entry, validation, and troubleshooting; support data integrity and process improvements as the FP&A tech stack is stood upCross-Functional Collaboration - Work with teams across the organization — including data center operations, energy, and engineering — to gather information, reconcile data, and ensure Finance assumptions reflect the latest business inputsProcess Improvement - Identify opportunities to streamline recurring tasks and improve reporting efficiency; contribute to building scalable FP&A processes as the function is established

SIGNALS OF SUCCESS

After 60 Days In This Role

Ramped on Crux's business model, capital structure, and current forecasting/reporting cadenceTaken ownership of at least one recurring reporting or reconciliation processEstablished working relationships with core cross-functional partners in Finance and the broader business

After 6 Months

Running point on variance analysis and reporting packages with minimal oversightContributing meaningfully to the build-out of the planning platform and supporting infrastructureTrusted to independently gather and validate inputs from business partners for the forecast cycle

After 1 Year

A go-to resource on the FP&A team for a defined area of the businessActively identifying and driving process improvements rather than just executing themPositioned to take on greater scope as the Finance organization scales alongside the business

Experiences

EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH

2–5 years of experience in FP&A, accounting, investment banking, consulting, or a related analytical roleStrong proficiency in Excel, including financial modeling, formulas, and data manipulation; experience with pivot tables, lookups, and building clean, auditable workbooksBonus points for experience with financial planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, Hyperion), BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), or ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle)Bonus points for industry experience in technology, data center infrastructure, cloud, or energyBachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a similar field

Attributes

Analytically curious, with the ability to work with large datasets, identify trends, and translate numbers into meaningful insightsHigh accuracy and thoroughness in work product; takes pride in getting the details rightClear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-finance audiencesCollaborative approach with a willingness to pitch in where needed; receptive to feedback and eager to learn

Mindset

You want to build, not just maintain — this is a ground-floor seat in a newly formed company, and the systems and processes you're supporting are still being definedYou have a high tolerance for ambiguity and are comfortable operating without a fully mature playbookYou're growth-oriented and want to develop broad FP&A expertise inside a fast-paced, capital-intensive business

Nice To Have (Preferred, Not Required)

Experience with financial planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, Hyperion) or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)Exposure to ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle)Industry experience in technology, data center infrastructure, cloud, or energy

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Crux

We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensationHealth, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependentsCompany-paid life insurance and disabilityFull suite of other optional benefits401(k) Plan with 4% company matchHybrid schedule offering four days in-office collaboration paired with one remote workday for focused, individual work

rows.title: Strategy Analyst - Cross Border Strategy & Operations
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Global Cross Border team is responsible for defining the cross border business strategy across travel and eCommerce and managing its execution across our five regions, working closely with market teams and cross-functional leaders around the world.

Cross Border is a key pillar of Visa’s 2030 strategy and one of the largest growth opportunities for Visa. Equally, it faces many complex and interesting challenges, touching all areas of the business, including product, pricing, legal, regulation, marketing, client engagement, and partnerships.

As a Strategy Analyst, you will play an important role in driving the growth and development of our cross border business through travel initiatives focused on issuers, merchants, and end-consumers. Additionally, you will support the buildout of the Visa Destinations platform (destinations.visa.com) by working with the regional and global cross border teams.

The successful candidate will work on innovative strategies that enhance our cross border travel value propositions and effectively target our global customer segments. By leveraging market insights, customer analytics, and competitive intelligence, you will develop and implement strategies across product, loyalty, offers, benefits, marketing services, and key customer segments. This role will interact extensively with regional and functional teams to ensure alignment with the company’s overall goals, driving commercial impact and long-term sustainable growth.

Essential Functions

Build winning strategies across key travel corridors.Support initiatives to strengthen our XB value proposition and help define our global strategy for target markets and corridorsHelp define our global strategy for travel personas (expats, students, etc.). Support investment prioritization and management across regions.Support work with key issuers and global clients to increase cross-border PV and market share

Scale Visa Destinations globally, growing our new, differentiated global travel platform.Help build out and fortify the value propositions of current destinations (e.g. Paris, NY), including sharing best practicesWork with regional XB teams to define the vision, strategy and value propositions of new destinations (e.g. Madrid, Tokyo, Egypt), and support execution.Support issuer adoption and value creation.

XB Travel Strategy and analyticsLeverage market, competitive and internal data to develop hypotheses and analyses to inform key strategic decisions (e.g. market prioritization, issuer prioritization, etc.)Support senior management updates and progress tracking
This is a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of strategy, partnerships, and execution—working with teams and clients around the world. We’re looking for someone who thrives in complexity, thinks globally, and executes with speed.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD)

Preferred Qualifications

Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

Mental/Physical Requirements

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

rows.title: Wellness Center Operations Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Wellness Center Operations Coordinator

A job at TSMC Arizona offers an opportunity to work at the most advanced semiconductor fab in the United States. TSMC Arizona’s first fab will operate its leading-edge semiconductor process technology (N4 process), starting production in the first half of 2025. The second fab will utilize its leading edge N3 and N2 process technology and be operational in 2028. The recently announced third fab will manufacture chips using 2nm or even more advanced process technology, with production starting by the end of the decade. America’s leading technology companies are ready to rely on TSMC Arizona for the next generations of chips that will power the digital future.

As a Wellness Center Operations Coordinator, you will demonstrate a strong sense of reliability and enthusiasm and will possess an attitude that embodies our core values – Integrity, Commitment, Innovation and Customer Trust.

In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for the seamless administrative and operational management of our company's on-site clinic. You will oversee daily clinic functions, financial processes, inter-departmental communications, and lead health promotion initiatives. This position requires a licensed nurse who is passionate about both healthcare administration and direct employee support.

rows.title: Founding Growth Marketer
rows.descriptionText:
⚠️ Please read first

This is a full-time, in-person role based in San Francisco (Presidio) - we work from the office 5 days a week. You must be based in the Bay Area or willing to relocate before starting. We require US work authorization , but are open to O-1 or J-1 visa sponsorship for exceptional candidates. 

About Sauna By Wordware

Every tool you use was built as an island, so you became the glue between them. You carry a name from Gmail into the CRM, a time from the CRM into Calendly, a note from Calendly into a doc. AI showed up and mostly became an eleventh window to paste into.

Sauna is a hybrid of AI and software standing on one shared brain. It holds your context and hands you real software built on top of it. You talk to it like a chatbot and use what it builds like an app: software for the path you repeat, AI for the edge that never repeats. Keep it to yourself, or share the brain with your team.

The clearest way to see it is a tool doing what its whole category cannot. An ordinary Calendly shows a stranger your free slots. Your Calendly writes the invite email itself, because it knows how the two of you know each other, and it offers a board member the slot over your gym block, because it knows which of your busy hours bend and for whom.

Wordware is the team behind it, 15 people backed by Spark Capital, Felicis, and Y Combinator with a $30M seed, the largest in YC's history. We build from an office in the Presidio, fifty metres from Crissy Field beach, and we work absurdly hard because we can see and feel the outcome every day.

About The Role

Here is the honest state of things.

People who try Sauna stay. Our week-two retention is 74%, which is the number investors care most about and the one we are proud of. Almost nobody knows the product exists. We have done no paid, no SEO, no affiliate, no referral loops, and nothing on lifecycle. Our top of funnel is a founder sending a hundred cold emails a day from his own inbox between product decisions.

That gap is the entire job. You will own demand: everything that takes a stranger from never having heard of Sauna to arriving and signing up. You get a real budget on day one, and you report directly to me.

Spend starts early here on purpose. Paid is the fastest way to find out whether the messaging, the creative, the positioning and the funnel actually work, and it answers in a week what content and interviews answer in a quarter. We will do the slow compounding work alongside it rather than waiting for it.

Retention and activation live with the product team. You bring quality people to the door and you own what it costs to get them there.

This is a making role before it is a managing role. For the first months you are the person writing the posts, briefing the videos, buying the media, and shipping the landing pages. Once a channel proves out, you hire against it.

The blank canvas is the appeal and the risk. There is no brand to inherit, no channel already half-working, and no historical performance data to defend. If that sounds like the best year of your career, we should talk.

Your First 30 Days

Before real money moves, the measurement has to be real. You will work with Amelia on analytics to stand up:

Conversion tracking that fires on the events that matter, server-side where it needs to be Match rate on Meta and enrichment score on Google, pushed as high as they go A fully loaded CAC that counts free trial credits as marketing spend, because they are An honest read on unit economics per channel, including inference cost, since usage is our cost of goods 

Sauna is a usage-based product with real variance in what a customer costs us. Meta and Google are not built for that. Getting the measurement right is what makes the rest of the job possible.

What You'll Do

Own the top of the funnel end to end: paid on Meta and Google first, then lifecycle, then everything that compounds around them. Run a creator program. A six-figure monthly Meta budget needs 400 to 500 fresh creatives a month to keep working. That is a program you build with creators and agencies, not a set of ads you write. Build an affiliate program and treat it as a real channel. Revenue share, a reason for people to earn before they are customers, and a public place to sign up. Build a content engine with the product itself as the subject. Use Sauna to do your own job in public, and show real work rather than talking about capabilities. Ship programmatic SEO and AEO with an engineering partner. Answer engines cite YouTube, Reddit, and credible third-party coverage, so the work runs wider than our own pages. Write the copy yourself. Landing pages, ads, emails, posts, video scripts. Run launches end to end: positioning, copy, social, email, video brief, press, community. Report one number every week: how many new people heard about Sauna and came to look, and what each one cost. 

Minimum

Who You Are:

You have run actual ads with your own hands. You picked the channel, wrote the creative, set the budget, read the numbers, and killed what was not working. You get a real budget here, so this is a floor. You understand what a conversion event is, why match rate matters, and what happens to a campaign when tracking is half broken. You have taken something from unknown to known. A product, a newsletter, a channel, a community, or your own company. You can tell me the starting number, the number a year later, and what you did in between. You are a systems thinker. You can step back from a task, map the whole system your job sits inside, and say which parts a machine should be doing. You have built something that does part of your job for you, with a feedback loop in it. Not a chat thread with context in it. A loop that gets better because you corrected it. You write unusually well. Punchy, specific, opinionated, and able to hold someone else's voice. You know what is working on X, YouTube, LinkedIn, and TikTok this month. You are technical enough to ship a landing page and brief SEO work without filing a ticket for every change. 

Bonus And Genuinely Not Required

You have priced or grown a usage-based product and know why LTV to CAC is not enough when inference is your cost of goods. You have run a UGC creator program or an affiliate program at real volume. A portfolio of work that traveled, with the numbers attached. Existing relationships with creators, newsletters, or AI community distribution channels. Already using Sauna, or something like it, as part of how you work. 

Probably Not a Fit If

You would only want to work on conversion inside a funnel that already has traffic. You need an established brand, a spend history, and a team in place before you can get moving. You would rather direct the work than make it. Your depth is one channel and you would rather stay in it. 

Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $150,000 to $250,000, depending on experience and how much of the role you can own from day one + meaningful early-stage equity.

You will also have a real media budget, set with Filip.

Standard Wordware benefits: medical, dental, and vision; daily lunch and dinner in the office; 401(k); gym budget; the Presidio office with a sauna and the beach across the road.

How To Apply

Answer one question in three paragraphs or fewer:

Tell us about a system you built that does part of your job for you. What was manual before, where does a human still touch it, and what happens when it produces something bad?

We read this before anything else on your application.

The Process

We keep our process simple. Exceptional candidates go from first touch to offer within 2 weeks.

Application: Submit your resume and answer a few short questions. 15-minute intro call: Quick check to align on location, motivation, and logistics. If it's a go, we move fast from here. Growth deep-dive: Walk through a channel you owned zero-to-scale and how you would approach ours. Final conversation: We answer your questions and scope out the work trial. Work trial: Paid, in person, usually a few days to two weeks. You work on a real project with us. See how we work, see if it fits, both sides.

rows.title: FP&A Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

What You'll Do

The FP&A Analyst reports to the VP, Financial Planning & Analysis and supports the Finance team in budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis across the organization. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how a capital-intensive, fast-growing infrastructure business operates and to build core FP&A skills from the ground floor of a newly formed company. You will support recurring financial processes, build and maintain models, and contribute to reporting that informs executive decision-making. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their FP&A career who wants broad exposure across corporate finance - including the capital planning that sits at the center of this business.

In This Role, You Will

Forecasting & Budgeting Support - Support the monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes by gathering inputs from business partners, maintaining templates, and ensuring timely and accurate submissionsFinancial Analysis - Perform variance analysis comparing actuals to budget and forecast; identify key drivers and prepare clear explanations for leadership reviewReporting - Assist in preparing monthly financial reports, executive summaries, and ad-hoc analyses; ensure data accuracy and consistency across deliverablesData Management - Help build and maintain the company's planning platform from the ground up, including data entry, validation, and troubleshooting; support data integrity and process improvements as the FP&A tech stack is stood upCross-Functional Collaboration - Work with teams across the organization — including data center operations, energy, and engineering — to gather information, reconcile data, and ensure Finance assumptions reflect the latest business inputsProcess Improvement - Identify opportunities to streamline recurring tasks and improve reporting efficiency; contribute to building scalable FP&A processes as the function is established

SIGNALS OF SUCCESS

After 60 Days In This Role

Ramped on Crux's business model, capital structure, and current forecasting/reporting cadenceTaken ownership of at least one recurring reporting or reconciliation processEstablished working relationships with core cross-functional partners in Finance and the broader business

After 6 Months

Running point on variance analysis and reporting packages with minimal oversightContributing meaningfully to the build-out of the planning platform and supporting infrastructureTrusted to independently gather and validate inputs from business partners for the forecast cycle

After 1 Year

A go-to resource on the FP&A team for a defined area of the businessActively identifying and driving process improvements rather than just executing themPositioned to take on greater scope as the Finance organization scales alongside the business

Experiences

EXPERIENCES, ATTRIBUTES AND MINDSET THAT INDICATE A GOOD MATCH

2–5 years of experience in FP&A, accounting, investment banking, consulting, or a related analytical roleStrong proficiency in Excel, including financial modeling, formulas, and data manipulation; experience with pivot tables, lookups, and building clean, auditable workbooksBonus points for experience with financial planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, Hyperion), BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI), or ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle)Bonus points for industry experience in technology, data center infrastructure, cloud, or energyBachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a similar field

Attributes

Analytically curious, with the ability to work with large datasets, identify trends, and translate numbers into meaningful insightsHigh accuracy and thoroughness in work product; takes pride in getting the details rightClear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-finance audiencesCollaborative approach with a willingness to pitch in where needed; receptive to feedback and eager to learn

Mindset

You want to build, not just maintain — this is a ground-floor seat in a newly formed company, and the systems and processes you're supporting are still being definedYou have a high tolerance for ambiguity and are comfortable operating without a fully mature playbookYou're growth-oriented and want to develop broad FP&A expertise inside a fast-paced, capital-intensive business

Nice To Have (Preferred, Not Required)

Experience with financial planning tools (e.g., Anaplan, Adaptive, Hyperion) or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)Exposure to ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle)Industry experience in technology, data center infrastructure, cloud, or energy

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been estimated based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

We offer generous base, bonus and additional incentive based compensationHealth, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependentsCompany-paid life insurance and disabilityFull suite of other optional benefits401(k) Plan with 4% company matchHybrid schedule offering four days in-office collaboration paired with one remote workday for focused, individual work

rows.title: Test Operator, ATE

Eurofins EAG Laboratories has over 40 years experience in engineering and materials testing services. Our parent company, Eurofins Scientific, is a multi-billion-dollar global leader in engineering and scientific services operating over 950 labs in 60 countries with 65,000 employees with a portfolio of over 200,000 validated analytical methods. 

At EAG, curiosity fuels everything we do. Every analysis, every test, and every question asked in our labs helps unlock what materials and products are capable of—and what the world can build next. If you’re energized by materials science, analytical chemistry, engineering rigor, and solving problems that matter, you’ll feel right at home here.

Our scientists and engineers support industries ranging from semiconductors and advanced electronics to pharmaceuticals, medical devices, energy systems, and consumer products. Using advanced techniques in analytical chemistry, microscopy, surface analysis, and engineering sciences, we help clients solve complex challenges across the product lifecycle.

What sets EAG apart isn’t just our world‑class instrumentation—it’s our people. We’re problem solvers, collaborators, and lifelong learners who value precision, curiosity, and impact. Here, your work directly influences the safety, reliability, and performance of products used around the globe.

Imagine the possibilities. Let’s explore them together.



Job Description

rows.title: Formulation Technician

Job Description

The Formulation Technician prepares, tests, and optimizes chemical solutions and formulations in a laboratory environment. This role focuses on developing new and improved chemical products, ensuring they meet strict safety, quality, and regulatory standards, and supporting the transition from lab-scale experiments to larger-scale production. The position requires close collaboration with technical teams and careful documentation of all work.

Responsibilities

Prepare chemical solutions and formulations following standardized procedures and experimental protocols.Conduct synthesis and blending of raw materials to develop new or improved chemical products.Operate laboratory equipment such as mixers, reactors, pH meters, and viscometers to support formulation and testing activities.Perform stability, purity, and potency testing on formulations to ensure product performance and reliability.Record detailed experimental data, observations, and test results in lab notebooks and digital systems with high accuracy.Assist in scaling formulations from laboratory development to pilot and full production, supporting process transfer and optimization.Troubleshoot formulation issues, identify root causes, and adjust component ratios or processing conditions as needed.Ensure all formulations comply with safety, quality, and regulatory requirements, including cGMP and OSHA guidelines.Collaborate closely with chemists, engineers, and quality control teams to support product development and continuous improvement.Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment, including proper handling, storage, and disposal of hazardous materials.

Essential Skills

1–3 years of experience in chemical formulation or synthesis.Strong understanding of chemical interactions, solubility, and stability.Ability to prepare and test chemical formulations using laboratory equipment such as mixers, reactors, pH meters, and viscometers.Familiarity with analytical techniques such as HPLC and spectroscopy.Knowledge of regulatory standards including GMP, GLP, and safe handling of Safety Data Sheets (SDS).Excellent documentation skills with the ability to record detailed and accurate data in lab notebooks and digital systems.Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve formulation and process issues.Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Experience assisting with scale-up of formulations from laboratory to pilot or full production environments.Comfort working with hazardous materials while following established safety protocols.Strong communication skills to interact effectively with chemists, engineers, and quality control professionals.

rows.title: Intern, R&D Graduate Year Round - Systems Analysis, Remote
rows.descriptionText:
What Your Job Will Be Like

We are seeking a year-round, graduate level intern to help with our systems analysis research and development. As part of our analytic staff, you will collaborate with experienced technical staff to advance projects that deepen understanding of complex systems, stakeholder dynamics, and strategic conflict phenomena. This internship offers the opportunity to contribute meaningful analytic work while developing hands-on expertise with methodological tools used across the national security community.

On any given day, you may contribute to activities in one or more of the following:

Undertake systematic investigation, analysis, or experimentation to discover or revise knowledge of system phenomena and discover new approaches to optimizing system performanceWork with multi-disciplinary teams to incorporate necessary subject matter expertise and domain knowledge for gaining an intimate knowledge of systems (human and/or machine) and their behaviorsBuild and evaluate frameworks that characterize multi-domain competition and conflictHelp design research-grade gamesDesign experiments to answer strategic questions, including variance and process modelingDesign analysis using qualitative, semi-quantitative, or quantitative methodsLead and contribute to technical publications and deliver presentations. 

The selected applicant can be a remote worker located in any U.S. State or District of Columbia. Regular or periodic travel to your assigned work location may be required.

Salary Range

At Sandia, we value the important work done by our interns and its contribution to National Security. Because of this, our interns earn competitive pay rates. Our pay structure is based on earned credit hours, classification, and degree level. Your pay rate will be determined during the hire process and included in your offer package. You can view the Intern Pay Rate chart here (https://www.sandia.gov/app/uploads/sites/51/2024/12/Student-Rate-Sheet-2025.docx) .

Qualifications We Require

You bring the confidence and skills to be eligible for the job by meeting these minimum requirements:

Earned bachelor's degreeCurrently attending and enrolled full time in an accredited science, engineering, or math graduate programMinimum cumulative GPA of 3.0/4.0Ability to work up to 30 hours per week during the academic year, and up to 40 hours per week during the summerAbility to secure and maintain a U.S. security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship

Note: If you have not yet started your graduate program, please apply to an undergraduate intern position.

Qualifications We Desire

Political Science, International Relations, or STEM disciplineStrong technical skills, especially demonstrated expertise/skill in conflict analysisExperience in at least one of the following methodologies: experimental design, qualitative research, analytic gamingStrong background in strategic conflict researchApplicants must be comfortable working in a collaborative environment as part of a team of engineers and researchersExcellent oral and written presentation skillsThe ideal candidate will have an interest in or experience with conducting self-driven research 

Posting Duration

This posting will be open for application submissions for a minimum of three (3) calendar days, including the 'posting date'. Sandia reserves the right to extend the posting date at any time.

About Our Team

Department 8716, Systems Analysis III, is part of Group 8710 (Systems Analysis & Reliability) in the Computation & Analysis for National Security Center (8700). The group delivers independent, objective analysis that provides leaders with reliable, unbiased insights on engineering and strategy options. We are a multi-department team supporting customers across multiple mission areas, including nuclear deterrence, science and energy, and global security, as well as providing internal support to Sandia. By applying advanced tools and methodologies, we combine technical expertise, cross-domain knowledge, and multiple analytic disciplines to help leaders make informed, risk-aware decisions.

About Sandia

Sandia National Laboratories is the nation’s premier science and engineering lab for national security and technology innovation, with teams of specialists focused on cutting-edge work in a broad array of areas. Some of the main reasons we love our jobs:

Challenging work with amazing impact that contributes to security, peace, and freedom worldwideExtraordinary co-workersSome of the best tools, equipment, and research facilities in the worldCareer advancement and enrichment opportunitiesFlexible work arrangements for many positions include 9/80 (work 80 hours every two weeks, with every other Friday off) and 4/10 (work 4 ten-hour days each week) compressed workweeks, part-time work, and telecommuting (a mix of onsite work and working from home)Generous vacation, strong medical and other benefits, competitive 401k, learning opportunities, relocation assistance and amenities aimed at creating a solid work/life balance*

World-changing technologies. Life-changing careers. Learn more about Sandia at: http://www.sandia.gov

These benefits vary by job classification.

Security Clearance

Sandia is required by DOE to conduct a pre-employment drug test and background review that includes checks of personal references, credit, law enforcement records, and employment/education verifications. Applicants for employment need to be able to obtain and maintain a DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. If you hold more than one citizenship (i.e., of the U.S. and another country), your ability to obtain a security clearance may be impacted.

Applicants offered employment with Sandia are subject to a federal background investigation to meet the requirements for access to classified information or matter if the duties of the position require a DOE security clearance. Substance abuse or illegal drug use, falsification of information, criminal activity, serious misconduct or other indicators of untrustworthiness can cause a clearance to be denied or terminated by DOE, resulting in the inability to perform the duties assigned and subsequent termination of employment.

Eeo

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status and any other protected class under state or federal law.

NNSA Requirements For MedPEDs

If you have a Medical Portable Electronic Device (MedPED), such as a pacemaker, defibrillator, drug-releasing pump, hearing aids, or diagnostic equipment and other equipment for measuring, monitoring, and recording body functions such as heartbeat and brain waves, if employed by Sandia National Laboratories you may be required to comply with NNSA security requirements for MedPEDs.

If you have a MedPED and you are selected for an on-site interview at Sandia National Laboratories, there may be additional steps necessary to ensure compliance with NNSA security requirements prior to the interview date.

About The Company

Valerie Health is the AI front office for independent provider groups. We are reimagining how independent practices operate by using AI to modernize patient and provider communication, enhance care, and drive industry changing operational efficiencies.

Why join us now?

Team: We are led by Pete Shalek (2x health tech exits, including a $600M acquisition by Optum) and Nitin Joshi (scaled Uber Eats + Health, Stripe Connect, and Bridge, acquired by Stripe for $1.1B). Beyond our founders, our team brings DNA from category leaders (Uber, Stripe, Meta), high growth unicorns, and top consulting firms.

Trajectory: We partner with leading independent provider groups across the U.S., automating hundreds of thousands of tasks each month. Scaling at 7x year-over-year with 300% NRR as customers consistently expand usage.

Funding: We have raised $39M from world class investors including Redpoint Ventures, General Catalyst, Primary Ventures, and BoxGroup.

About The Role

Operations Specialists are the operators behind Valerie’s AI platform. Each specialist owns the operational delivery for a set of partner medical groups, ensuring their workflows run accurately, efficiently, and reliably.

You will serve as the primary operational owner (Ops POC) for assigned customers, responsible for maintaining high-quality execution while helping improve the systems and workflows that power Valerie’s platform.

For high-performing team members, this role offers meaningful growth opportunities within the first 6-12 months. As Valerie scales, strong operators often expand their scope beyond core workflow execution to drive process improvements, support automation initiatives, and help shape how operations runs across new partners and products.

Working inside a fast-growing AI-native company also provides exposure to how different parts of the business operate, including operations, engineering, and customer teams. This environment creates opportunities for strong performers to grow into new roles within Valerie over time, while developing skills that translate well across the broader startup ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

Own Operational Delivery for Customers: Serve as the primary operations POC for partner practices, ensuring their workflows run smoothly and meet quality and performance expectations, including supporting the rollout and implementation of new product lines. Execute Core Platform Workflows: Process and verify patient and practice data through Valerie’s internal systems with high accuracy and speed. Maintain Quality and Data Integrity: Identify discrepancies, edge cases, and workflow issues and resolve or escalate them quickly to maintain platform reliability. Improve Operational Systems: Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve workflow efficiency, and strengthen operational processes. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with Central Operations, Engineering, and Customer teams to surface issues, provide operational insights, and help improve the platform. 

About You

Experience:

Bachelor’s degree with a strong academic track record or equivalent experience with a trajectory of high achievement. Early-career candidates are encouraged to apply. Prior startup, operations, or healthcare experience is helpful but not required. Demonstrated ability to learn new systems, tools, and workflows quickly. 

Attributes:

Ownership Mindset: Takes responsibility for outcomes and treats assigned customers and workflows as their own. High Attention to Detail: Able to work quickly while maintaining extremely high accuracy. Execution Speed: Moves with urgency and follows through to completion. Problem Solver: Comfortable identifying issues, diagnosing root causes, and driving improvements. Strong Communicator: Clear written and verbal communication with teammates and cross-functional partners. Thrives in a Startup Environment: Comfortable working in ambiguity and adapting as the company grows. 

Own your impact

We hire exceptional people and hold them to a high standard. We're scaling rapidly and solving real problems for providers. You'll own your work end to end, with the autonomy to make the decisions that matter. The pace is demanding and the work is intense.

What we offer

Competitive salary, equity and benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and lunch served on in-office daysCareer trajectory: This role is a launchpad for early-career operators, with opportunities to grow into new roles as the company scalesSF office: Daily catered lunch and dinner reimbursement

Compensation Range: $65K - $85K

rows.title: Strategy Analyst - Cross Border Strategy & Operations
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

The Global Cross Border team is responsible for defining the cross border business strategy across travel and eCommerce and managing its execution across our five regions, working closely with market teams and cross-functional leaders around the world.

Cross Border is a key pillar of Visa’s 2030 strategy and one of the largest growth opportunities for Visa. Equally, it faces many complex and interesting challenges, touching all areas of the business, including product, pricing, legal, regulation, marketing, client engagement, and partnerships.

As a Strategy Analyst, you will play an important role in driving the growth and development of our cross border business through travel initiatives focused on issuers, merchants, and end-consumers. Additionally, you will support the buildout of the Visa Destinations platform (destinations.visa.com) by working with the regional and global cross border teams.

The successful candidate will work on innovative strategies that enhance our cross border travel value propositions and effectively target our global customer segments. By leveraging market insights, customer analytics, and competitive intelligence, you will develop and implement strategies across product, loyalty, offers, benefits, marketing services, and key customer segments. This role will interact extensively with regional and functional teams to ensure alignment with the company’s overall goals, driving commercial impact and long-term sustainable growth.

Essential Functions

Build winning strategies across key travel corridors.Support initiatives to strengthen our XB value proposition and help define our global strategy for target markets and corridorsHelp define our global strategy for travel personas (expats, students, etc.). Support investment prioritization and management across regions.Support work with key issuers and global clients to increase cross-border PV and market share

Scale Visa Destinations globally, growing our new, differentiated global travel platform.Help build out and fortify the value propositions of current destinations (e.g. Paris, NY), including sharing best practicesWork with regional XB teams to define the vision, strategy and value propositions of new destinations (e.g. Madrid, Tokyo, Egypt), and support execution.Support issuer adoption and value creation.

XB Travel Strategy and analyticsLeverage market, competitive and internal data to develop hypotheses and analyses to inform key strategic decisions (e.g. market prioritization, issuer prioritization, etc.)Support senior management updates and progress tracking
This is a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of strategy, partnerships, and execution—working with teams and clients around the world. We’re looking for someone who thrives in complexity, thinks globally, and executes with speed.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD)

Our parent company, Eurofins Scientific, is a multi-billion-dollar global leader in engineering and scientific services operating over 950 labs in 60 countries with 65,000 employees with a portfolio of over 200,000 validated analytical methods. 

At EAG, curiosity fuels everything we do. Every analysis, every test, and every question asked in our labs helps unlock what materials and products are capable of—and what the world can build next. If you’re energized by materials science, analytical chemistry, engineering rigor, and solving problems that matter, you’ll feel right at home here.

Our scientists and engineers support industries ranging from semiconductors and advanced electronics to pharmaceuticals, medical devices, energy systems, and consumer products. Using advanced techniques in analytical chemistry, microscopy, surface analysis, and engineering sciences, we help clients solve complex challenges across the product lifecycle.

What sets EAG apart isn’t just our world‑class instrumentation—it’s our people. We’re problem solvers, collaborators, and lifelong learners who value precision, curiosity, and impact. Here, your work directly influences the safety, reliability, and performance of products used around the globe.

Imagine the possibilities. Let’s explore them together.

Ability to move equipment or items up to 25 lbs.
