rows.title: Brand & Digital Director, Sam’s Club Customer Team
rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

FAYETTEVILLE SALES OFFICE

Job Description

About P&G:

P&G serves nearly 5 billion people around the world with our brands. We have one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Pampers®, Tide®, Charmin®, Gillette®, and Crest®. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide. P&G is driven to be a force for good and a force for growth, with a focus on environmental sustainability and community impact. Join us to make an impact on brands consumers love and help us grow a better world.

P&G is seeking an experienced and dynamic Brand & Digital Director to lead our marketing efforts for the Sam’s Club customer team. This pivotal role prioritizes performance marketing and digital acceleration as key drivers for sustainable growth, with a significant portion of business transacted digitally. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional marketing and digital leader with a passion for transforming consumer insights into digital engagement, driving aggressive growth in a dynamic retail environment, and possessing deep expertise across digital acceleration, performance marketing, and capability building. The candidate will also have a strong understanding of shopper behavior, shopper marketing activations, and a demonstrated ability to collaborate and manage customer team dynamics.

You will be responsible for defining and executing digital-first marketing strategies that accelerate user growth across P&G categories and deliver superior value for our consumers at Sam's Club. This will include combining a portfolio of P&G brand strategies to win consumers with advanced digital and retail media capabilities, leveraging analytics and performance marketing principles to optimize our go-to-market execution. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, possess profound digital acumen, and are ready to shape the future of brand engagement at the point of sale, we invite you to apply.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Acceleration & Performance Marketing Leadership: Own and drive digital growth strategy and execution across all relevant platforms, ensuring market-leading category growth within digital channels. Develop and implement comprehensive performance marketing strategies to improve item conversion, increase traffic, and optimize online purchasing. This includes designing both offsite and onsite traffic strategies and plans, identifying retail search and digital content needs, and creating online merchandising strategies with continuous optimization. Lead the integration and activation of digital media within Sam's Club's ecosystem, leveraging member insights and utilizing both P&G and Sam's media capabilities across Fabric, Home, and Family categories. Leverage analytics and consumer insights to uncover actionable shopper motivations and barriers, translating these into effective digital marketing programs. Define, align, and champion the digital vision for P&G at Sam's Club, collaborating with P&G and Sam's leadership to shape future digital activation strategies. Utilize A/B testing, structured experimentation, and continuous optimization frameworks to refine campaign effectiveness, ad copy, creative assets, and landing page experiences on retailer platform. Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as page views, conversion rates, incremental return on ad spend (iROAS) and overall incrementality to drive continuous improvement and optimize media investments and online content. Digital Capability Building & Team Development: Identify key digital capability gaps within the Sam's Club commercial organization and proactively develop supporting systems, training, and upskilling plans to fuel sustained digital growth across the team. Test and learn new platforms, technologies, and retailer capabilities, evaluating their potential to scale and recommending successful initiatives across the business. Elevate the team's digital skills through training and skill development related to new capabilities, establishing best practices, and scaling successes. Customer Team & Shopper Marketing: Develop and execute shopper marketing strategies and activations specific to Sam's Club, spanning both digital and in-store touchpoints to drive member engagement and sales. Partner across the P&G Sam's Club Commercial organization and Sam’s Club team to deliver digital sales growth through identifying category-specific digital growth models and implementing plans to improve overall business performance. Connect P&G Brands with Members by leveraging the P&G Household Needs portfolio to create omni-channel moments that resonate and align with Sam's Club's strategic priorities. Collaborate with Sales Directors to sell-in marketing programs to brands and categories to secure superior retail execution. 

Job Qualifications

What We Are Looking For:

Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree (e.g., MBA) preferred. 8+ years of digital marketing experience, with a focus on performance marketing and digital acceleration within a fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) company, preferably with experience in a club or mass retail environment. Demonstrated expertise in digital commerce fundamentals, marketing technology (AI, algorithms, off-the-shelf platforms), search strategy, content superiority, and overall digital ecosystem management. Proven track record of delivering measurable business results and driving market share growth through effective, data-driven digital strategies and commercial acumen. Superior Retail Execution: Deep understanding of retail and retailer dynamics, effective engagement across retailers and brands, and a focus on category growth. Superior Brand Communication: Experience in media planning, media data analytics, and performance marketing. Strong strategic, analytical, and leadership capabilities to influence diverse stakeholders, translate complex data and digital performance metrics into clear plans, and drive organizational change. Exceptional learning agility, embracing an "at retail" speed entrepreneurial spirit and proactively seeking knowledge to expand impact. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to influence diverse stakeholders internally and externally, including senior retail partners. Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. 

Starting Pay/Salary Range: $144,000 – $190,000

Job Description:

Mars Pet Nutrition NA - Director Consumer Technical Insights

The Consumer Technical Insight team translates pet and pet parent research and Insights into competitive product experience design for Mars Pet Nutrition North America (PNNA). This role leads a team of associates and drives competitiveness of the portfolio by developing competitive innovation and product design strategy rooted in market, consumer, pets, trends and competitor insights. The role will also build out a scalable model for technical competitive intelligence.

This position will ensure that the overall R&D innovation, renovation and value leadership program is shaped and delivered with pet and pet parent insight at its heart, so that we design and deliver superior pet parent product experiences, drive Superior Proposition of our Core and deliver category building innovation. By using best in class consumer and sensory research approaches, data analytics tools and techniques, and rigorous logic this role will leverage consumer empathy, deep qualitative research as well as quantify and interpret data and then translate into clear insights and recommendations to the business. This role will remain current with sensory, consumer science, and product research methodologies and continuously stay abreast of new developments in the field, actively implementing them within the business.

This leader will be part of our North America R&D leadership team and Global CTI community. There will be a focus on playing a key strategic role in building our capabilities for the future, partnering with the Global CTI Senior Director and championing pet and pet parent centricity and Superior Proposition in the NA R&D team and RDLT

What are we looking for?

Minimum of BS degree in a STEM field (Engineering, Chemistry, Food Science, etc.). Advanced degree preferred.Minimum of 10 years' experience in R&D. CPG/Food Industry experience preferred.Minimum of 5 years' experience in qualitative and quantitative product and consumer research methodologies and techniquesDemonstrated understanding of applying product and consumer research methods, data analysis, and insight synthesis leading to measurable product performance and acceptance improvements.Strong team orientation and ability to work collaboratively across regions and with cross functional partnersExpertise in translating key learnings and insights into actionable plans & strategies.Preferred experiences: Understanding of the pet food/food industry, consumer trends, scientific innovations, data analytics and its relation to sensory and consumer science; and relevant Sensory and Consumer Science software and statistical skills.

What will be your Key Responsibilities?

Champion pet and pet parent voice as part of the NA RDLT, ensuring R&D strategy and plans are integrating pet and pet parent needs and innovation / renovation / VL activities are shaped to deliver towards pet and parent needs. This includes ensuring that product experience CSFs are aligned and delivered to ensure projects deliver against product job-to-be-done and meet our Superior Proposition ambition. rows.title: Sr. Data Scientist II
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

Numerator is seeking a Sr. Data Scientist II (Bayesian Modeling) to help build, enhance, and scale data science services across our rapidly evolving data platform. You’ll work end-to-end on initiatives that turn massive proprietary datasets into impactful, production-grade solutions.

This is a highly autonomous, product-focused role. You’ll partner with Product, Data, and Engineering teams to translate customer needs into data-driven products, analytics methodologies, and new offerings that drive measurable business impact.

How You'll Spend Your Time:

Lead the design and delivery of complex Bayesian and probabilistic modeling pipelines, from methodology through production Set technical direction on hard modeling problems and make the key methodological calls, with a high degree of autonomy Work closely with Product, GTM, Data, and Engineering to turn models into reliable, production-grade solutions the business can depend on Help the whole team get better — mentor other data scientists, share your approach openly, and raise the bar for how the group reasons about uncertainty and Bayesian methods Communicate methods, results, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 

What You'll Bring to Numerator

Strong foundation in Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling — e.g. hierarchical / multilevel models, state-space and time-series models, graphical models, MCMC/HMC, variational and other approximate inference Experience applying these methods to real, messy, production data — not only research or coursework Comfort reasoning about uncertainty, calibration, and model validation Facility with large or structured datasets and the computational side of inference at scale Strong Python, and fluency in a modern probabilistic-programming and numerical-computing stack — NumPyro, PyMC, Stan, JAX, dynamax, or similar. We hire on the ideas, not on exact tooling Track record of shipping statistical models into production BS or PhD in Statistics, Math, Economics, Physics, CS, or a related quantitative field 8+ years of industry experience as a data scientist (or equivalent role/work) with a BS in the above-mentioned areas, or 5+ years of industry experience with a PhD in a quantitative field Clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences 

Nice to Haves:

Diagnosing and debugging large Bayesian models — convergence and divergence issues, pinning down which part of a big model is misbehaving, and knowing which inference method to reach for Weighting a non-representative survey or panel sample up to a known population, and a feel for where those adjustments break down Hierarchical models spanning multiple crossed or overlapping groupings — relationships that bridge hierarchies, not just a single nested tree Experience with graph or network models, or modeling relational / graph-structured data Measurement-error modeling, or reconciling multiple imperfect data sources CPG / FMCG / retail experience, or work with user-level purchase or panel data

rows.title: Research Consultant (Survey)
rows.descriptionText:
We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together.

At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it.

The salary range for this role is $73,000 - $90,000/year + Bonus

Numerator Verified Voices combines verified purchase behavior with mobile surveys to unlock consumer and shopper insights that build stronger brands. Powered by the industry's largest and most diverse consumer purchase panel, our Research Consulting team delivers unmatched insight into consumer influencers, behaviors, and opinions, and we deliver actionable, decision-driving insights for some of the world's leading brands.

As a Research Consultant on Numerator's Research Consulting team, you'll independently own client relationships across a core set of clients and ad-hoc projects. You will act as a trusted advisor to your clients by synthesizing complex data into clear insights, building compelling narratives, and delivering actionable recommendations that strengthen client partnerships and directly influence business decisions. You will guide clients to the right research solution - full-service custom, DIY, or do-it-together - while protecting scope, quality, and timelines. This role requires strong judgment, comfort operating with minimal oversight, and the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, including thoughtful AI use, comfort with ambiguity, and clear client expectation-setting.

How You’ll Spend Your Time: 

Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients and ad-hoc projects, owning client relationships end-to-end, delegating to members of your project team as needed, and building strong cross-functional partnerships with Sales, Consulting, and Operations. Own the full project life cycle for client-specific work - from scoping and project design (including proposal writing and pricing as needed) through execution - covering project design, questionnaire development, sample definition, data tabulation and analysis, client-ready deliverables, and presentation of results. Design and deliver both custom, full-service research and tech-enabled, DIY survey solutions on Numerator's platform, guiding clients towards the right approach based on objectives, timelines, budget and capabilities. Support clients using Numerator’s platform by offering the appropriate level of help, whether that means answering questions, providing education, recommending A La Carte services, or supporting subscription-based work. Help clients understand what the platform can do, what support is available, and when a request may need a different service model. Set clear expectations before work begins by clarifying the client’s request, confirming timing and level of effort, and aligning on what is included. Manage scope carefully, especially when client needs fall in the gray area between in-platform support and full-service custom research. Apply a strong understanding of quantitative research methodologies, sampling approaches, industry standards, and intermediate panel structures to design high quality research. Identify opportunities for advanced analytics and effectively interpret results, partnering with internal analytics experts as needed. Go beyond reporting results to deliver high-level insights, strategic storytelling, and clear actionable recommendations tailored to client business questions. Use AI-enabled tools as part of a thoughtful, accountable workflow to improve speed, quality, synthesis, project planning, and deliverable development while validating outputs and maintaining Numerator's standards for accuracy and client readiness. Leverage Numerator’s shopper panel and collaborate with the Consulting team to create holistic, high-impact research designs and outputs. Contribute to broader client strategy in partnership with the account team and provide support for sales initiatives. Manage client workload and multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision/oversight required, prioritizing effectively while maintaining a high bar for quality and client service. Delegate appropriately to and mentor Research Analysts and Research Operations partners, providing clear direction, feedback and support. Travel, as required, to support the above responsibilities.

Demonstrated experience working with clients to translate their business questions and objectives into a research design. Strong command of survey research methodologies, questionnaire design, sampling strategies and data analysis techniques. Advanced storytelling, data visualization, and presentation skills, with a track record of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights. Proven ability to independently manage and grow client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor to mid- to senior-level client stakeholders. Proven ability to manage multiple projects at varying stages simultaneously, with the ability to prioritize accordingly while maintaining superior client service. Comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment, including experience with or openness to tech-enabled and DIY research platforms. Strong technical curiosity and comfort supporting platform, self-service, or do-it-together workflows; able to translate platform capabilities and limitations into clear client guidance. Demonstrated AI fluency or strong willingness to build AI fluency: uses AI thoughtfully to support core work, understands tool limitations, validates outputs, and owns the final work product. Ability to operate in ambiguity, set clear expectations, and manage client boundaries in a consultative way. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

An inclusive and collaborative company culture- we work in an open environment while working together to get things done, and adapt to the changing needs as they come. Market competitive total compensation package. Volunteer time off and charitable donation matching. Strong support for career growth, including mentorship programs, leadership training, access to conferences and employee resource groups. Great benefits package including health/vision/dental, Personal Spending Account, unlimited PTO, flexible schedule, 401K matching, travel reimbursement and more.

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

The Business Intelligence Analyst plays a critical role in transforming complex retail and consumer data into scalable, business-ready solutions that power client insights, automation, reporting, analytics, and new product capabilities. This role combines technical expertise, business acumen, and strategic thinking to maximize the value of organizational data and drive measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced problem solver who can bridge technical and business teams, translate complex requirements into actionable solutions, and identify creative approaches to address business challenges. They are passionate about data, curious about emerging AI technologies, and comfortable working directly with Client Development teams, Product, Operations, and other stakeholders.

Job Responsibilities

Data Transformation & Activation

Design, develop, and maintain data transformation processes that cleanse, structure, enrich, and convert raw data into business-ready datasets. Build and optimize scalable data pipelines that support reporting, analytics, automation, and client deliverables. Identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve efficiency through automation. 

Unify Development

Design and implement data integration solutions, including the development of Connector Models and Genius Script reporting within Unify. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to improve platform capabilities and performance. Troubleshoot and resolve data integration and connector-related issues. 

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Explore and implement AI-driven approaches that improve data preparation, automation, insight generation, and user productivity. Partner with stakeholders to identify practical applications of AI that create measurable business value. Contribute to best practices, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the team. 

Business Partnership & Solution Design

Partner with Client Development, Product, and Operations teams to translate business challenges into scalable data solutions. Gather requirements and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 

Requirements

5+ years of experience in data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, data activation, or a related field. Proven experience designing and implementing data transformation and integration solutions. Experience working directly with business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver solutions. 

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, USA.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $65,000.00 to $72,000.00 USD.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Community Relations Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.



Job Description

As the Specialist – Community Relations, reporting to the Manager – Community Relations and Culture, you will help advance Domino's philanthropic and community engagement efforts through charitable giving, nonprofit partnerships, and compelling storytelling that demonstrates our impact. You will work cross-functionally to execute the annual fundraising campaign for St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, helping advance Domino's bold ambition to raise $300 million by 2034. Through strategic nonprofit partnerships, community engagement initiatives, and compelling storytelling, you will showcase the impact of our community relations efforts while strengthening alignment across the Domino's system, building trust with key stakeholders, and enhancing the reputation of one of the world's most recognized consumer brands.

Responsibilities

Manage community investment programs by cultivating relationships with nonprofit organizations, evaluating giving opportunities, and coordinating monetary and in-kind contributions aligned with Domino's values and community impact strategy.Coordinate local and supply chain outreach initiatives by partnering with Supply Chain leaders, Business Consultants, and community organizations to deliver meaningful support and engagement opportunities.Administer charitable giving programs, including donation tracking, budget management, impact measurement, and stewardship of pizza relief and donation initiatives.Support national fundraising campaigns by helping plan, execute, and optimize initiatives that drive participation, engagement, and results for Domino's national charity partner.Develop campaign communications and engagement strategies in partnership with cross-functional teams to increase awareness, participation, and fundraising impact.Track and report campaign performance through fundraising analytics, stakeholder updates, and recognition programs that celebrate achievements and reinforce campaign goals.Create compelling community impact content that highlights Domino's charitable contributions, volunteerism, nonprofit partnerships, and commitment to social good.Manage community relations communication channels, including PieNet and other digital platforms, ensuring content remains current, engaging, and aligned with company priorities.Integrate community impact storytelling across enterprise channels by partnering with Internal Communications, Public Relations, and Social Media teams to amplify key initiatives and moments.Develop impact reports and stakeholder updates that demonstrate the reach and value of Domino's community investments to internal and external audiences.Support national partner activations through event coordination, volunteer opportunities, fundraising initiatives, and engagement programs that strengthen strategic nonprofit relationships.Serve as a community relations ambassador by representing Domino's at community events and fostering meaningful relationships with nonprofit partners and stakeholders.

Qualifications

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experiencePassion for Community Impact: You have a genuine commitment to strengthening communities and advancing purpose-driven initiatives.Compelling storyteller: You have the ability to develop clear, engaging content for diverse audiences across digital, written, and multimedia channels.Demonstrate Attention to Detail: Through strong proofreading, editing, organization, and project management skills.Build Relationships: Collaborate with internal teams and partners, and professionally represent Domino's with nonprofit partners, stakeholders, and community leaders.Education: Bachelor’s degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, business or a related field.Travel: Occasional travel may be required, estimated at less than 5% of the role

rows.title: Client Development Manager - Hybrid: Chicago
rows.descriptionText:
Client Development Manager

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, retailers, and foodservice operators. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at www.circana.com.

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action. Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence. Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities. Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context. Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times. Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change. 

What will you be doing? 

Serve as a trusted advisor to leading foodservice manufacturer and operator clients by building strategic relationships, understanding business objectives and challenges, and translating insights into growth opportunities. Leverage Circana’s broad portfolio of foodservice data assets and proprietary tools to analyze complex consumer and industry data, delivering clear, actionable recommendations that inform business decisions. Drive client success and satisfaction by proactively connecting market trends and performance data to strategic opportunities while expanding engagement across a broader range of stakeholders and end users. Support team development by thoughtfully managing and developing a junior direct report. 

Job Responsibilities

Drive Client Growth: Identify and pursue opportunities to expand client relationships by aligning Circana’s data and software solutions with their strategic goals. Deliver Insight-Led Solutions: Translate complex data into actionable insights that help clients make informed decisions and achieve measurable outcomes. Manage the Sales Cycle: Lead end-to-end sales processes including prospecting, needs assessment, solution development, negotiation, and closing. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with internal teams (e.g., Product, Analytics) to deliver integrated solutions and ensure client success. Maintain Industry Expertise: Stay current on trends in [retail, CPG, or general merchandise] to position Circana as a thought leader and trusted advisor. Build Strategic Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organizations, including decision-makers and influencers. Utilize Sales Tools and Platforms: Leverage Circana’s proprietary platforms (e.g., Unify+, Liquid Data, Intelligence Suite) to support client engagements and solution delivery. Achieve Revenue Targets: Meet or exceed individual and team sales goals through disciplined pipeline management and strategic account planning. Champion Client Success: Ensure client satisfaction by proactively addressing challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering consistent value. Support Innovation and Feedback: Provide market feedback to internal teams to help refine offerings and contribute to product development. Advanced Analytic Skills: Demonstrated ability to conceive, manage, and deliver fact-based analyses, with a focus on consumer solutions, providing clients with clear, actionable insights to inform strategy. 

Requirements

BA/BS or equivalent degree required. Market research, economics, statistics, or marketing background preferred. 6+ years of relevant professional experience required. Foodservice industry experience preferred. Highly proficient in all MS Office products (strong Excel, PowerPoint, CoPilot). Prior experience with Circana’s proprietary tools like Unify+ is a plus. Ability to travel as needed (

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions. Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action. Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices. Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers. Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement. Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity. Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone. 

Location 

This position can be located in the following area(s): Hybrid role based in Chicago, IL

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice ) Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $85,000 to $105,000.

This job is also eligible for annual incentive plan (AIP) pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

rows.title: Lead Product Designer

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
What is Bilt?

Bilt is the membership for where you live.

What started as a way to reward people on their largest expense has turned into an ecosystem connecting our members, property managers and local merchants.

Travel, dining, fitness, everyday spend. We are building systems across payments, credit, loyalty, and commerce all at once.

We run lean and move quickly. Every person here has a real impact on what gets built and how fast it happens.

This role comes with real ownership and high expectations. If you prefer clearly defined lanes and structure, this will feel uncomfortable. If you want to build quickly, have a real say in what gets built, and work on products used by millions, you will likely do your best work here.

What’s the role?

As a Design team member at Bilt, you’ll be instrumental in shaping the experiences we build and how our users interact with them. You’ll be reporting to our Head of Product Design and leading the design initiatives within your dedicated pod, creating enterprise and consumer-facing experiences that align with both user needs and business objectives.

In this role, you will… 

Own product development end to end, from initial concept through shipping and beyondBuild wireframes and prototypes that convey your ideas and communicate your solutions to the broader team & stakeholdersConduct research and utilize data to inform product decisions while keeping the customer at the center of everythingWork alongside engineers to ensure the product is implemented to exacting standards and a high level of polishShip, measure, and improve the product based on quantitative and qualitative feedbackIdentify future opportunities, working as a thought partner to the Product, Marketing, and Engineering teamsDefine our design system and scale it thoughtfully so as to maintain consistency and cohesiveness throughout our products

Who You Are

You have great instincts about what users want and how they think, but you aren’t afraid to get the data you need to make product decisions.You’re a storyteller, both verbally and visually, and you can create insightful user stories and prototypes that align the team around product features.You don’t just deliver mockups—you work with other teams to deliver a holistic user experience that encompasses technical logic, edge cases, accessibility, product marketing, and success metrics.You’re not an engineer, but you know their lingo, and you have the chops to balance product scope with engineering effort.You can work fast and loose if needed, but you also understand when process and structure are necessary, and you have ideas about how to implement them.

In Terms Of Qualifications, We’re Seeking

5+ years of product design or UX design experience, or combined product management and design experienceA portfolio showing high-quality, impactful UX, UI, and product workMastery in wireframing, interaction, and prototyping tools, including Figma.Experience in UX Analytics and Research is a plusExperience in Product Management is a plusExperience in Front End development is a plus

Benefits

Compensation - We offer a competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity and our performance bonus programHealth insurance for you (& your loved ones) from day one - Enjoy a One Medical Membership, wellness stipends, family programs and more, on us. We’ve got you and your family covered from day one.401k plan with a match - Retirement may feel more like a pipe dream than a reality but we’re here to help you get there.Commuter FSAs - We believe the best ideas come from being together in one place. We just don’t think getting there should be so expensive.UNLIMITED PTO - Because we believe that working hard shouldn’t mean always working. Take time for you as often as you need it.Exclusive Employee only Bilt Points - We give our employees unique opportunities to earn points throughout their time at Bilt.Team Events - We believe in human connection so we hold events to help our employees break from the monotony of the typical work week.

At Bilt Rewards, we believe in transparency and we do our best to make sure the company and our candidates are on the same page as it relates to compensation. In addition to posting salary ranges for our open roles, candidates should expect to be asked about compensation expectations and requirements early on in their interview process. Our goal is to highlight when expectations and Bilt’s salary range may be out of sync, and work with the candidate to determine whether it makes sense to continue conversations.

We are considering candidates with differing levels of expertise for this position. Leveling will be based upon your experience and performance in the interview process.

Where a new hire falls within a range will be based on their individual skills and experience, and how these competencies compare across other employees in the same role. Bilt's bands are designed to allow for individual compensation growth within the role. As such, new hires typically start at the lower end of the range. Bilt rewards performance and outcomes - should you join the company, you will have the opportunity to grow your salary over time.

The salary range for a Lead Product Designer is $160,000 - 215,000 and will be eligible for equity and an annual performance-based bonus.

rows.title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.   About the teamAt Roku, the UI Systems team builds the high-performance engines and core graphics infrastructure that power millions of devices. We own the low-level C++ frameworks, rendering pipelines, and system architectures that enable smooth navigation and rich animations. Our work sits at the intersection of hardware and software, where we optimize graphics rendering, memory management, and layout engines to ensure a consistent, lightning-fast experience across our entire device portfolio. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment, partnering closely with firmware and silicon teams to push the boundaries of what’s possible on embedded hardware.About the roleAs a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a key architect of the core systems that underpin Roku’s user experience. You will design and implement performance-critical code within our UI engine, focusing on graphics primitives, memory efficiency, and hardware acceleration. You’ll tackle complex systems-level challenges—such as optimizing frame rates on resource-constrained hardware and building robust APIs for higher-level frameworks. This role is ideal for engineers who thrive on low-level systems programming, care about performance down to the microsecond, and want to build the high-performance foundations that power the future of television.What you’ll be doingArchitect and optimize core C++ UI frameworks and rendering engines to ensure buttery-smooth performance across a diverse range of hardware profiles. Lead technical investigations into system-level bottlenecks, memory leaks, and GPU/CPU synchronization issues. Develop and maintain low-level graphics APIs and layout systems that serve as the backbone for Roku’s application ecosystem. Integrate AI/ML capabilities at the systems level, leveraging generative AI tools to optimize code generation and automate performance profiling. Collaborate with firmware and driver teams to leverage hardware-specific optimizations and ensure seamless integration with the underlying OS. Mentor junior developers through deep-dive code reviews, architectural design sessions, and technical documentation of core systems. Drive engineering excellence by implementing advanced debugging tools, automated performance regression suites, and modern C++ best practices. We’re excited if you haveMinimum of 5+ years of software engineering experience with a heavy focus on C++ (C++14/17/20). Deep understanding of systems programming, including memory management, multi-threading, and hardware-software abstraction layers. Experience with graphics APIs (e.g., OpenGL, Vulkan, or proprietary embedded graphics stacks) and rendering pipelines. Proficiency in Python for tooling and automation, with a working knowledge of BrightScript or JavaScript being a significant plus. Strong root cause analysis skills, specifically using tools like GDB, Valgrind, or platform-specific profilers. Knowledge of AI applications and hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate systems-level development. A proactive mindset with a passion for squeezing every drop of performance out of embedded systems and a commitment to data-driven optimization.    Our Hybrid Work ApproachRoku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are flexible for remote work except for employees whose roles are required to be in the office five days a week or employees who are in offices with a five day in office policy. BenefitsRoku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Our employees can take time off work for vacation and other personal reasons to balance their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. The Roku CultureRoku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

We operate in a hybrid environment working 3 days a week from our offices in Kings Cross and 2 days a week remotely.
We value and respect all differences (seen and unseen) in all people. We aspire to have inclusive working experiences and an environment that reflects the audience we serve, where our people have equal access to career development opportunities, their voices are heard and can contribute to our future. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Many of our staff work flexibly and we will consider all requests for flexible working arrangements.

To apply, please upload your latest CV and a cover letter which outlines why you’d love to take on this role, and why you’re a great match for what we’re looking for.

The closing date for applications is Monday 28th September 2026.
All roles at the Guardian are open for everybody to apply. It is important to us that you feel supported and comfortable throughout your recruitment process, in order to perform your best. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to help your application, this includes providing documents in accessible formats or personalising the process to better support your needs.

Our pension scheme is generous; if you contribute 5% then we will contribute 8-12% (depending on your age). We believe in giving back, which is why employees are given 2 volunteering days annually and the option of payroll giving. Season ticket loans are also available.
You are entitled to private healthcare, life cover, income protection, and eye tests. You can also opt in to dental insurance.
We have enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental leave policies in place. We also support our employees by offering an IVF, menopause, baby loss, and trans equality policy.

rows.title: Effectiveness Manager, Media
rows.descriptionText:
Workplace: White City, London - 2 days a week in the office
The role
We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, do-er to act as the guardian of our measurement framework and the engine behind its operations. In this role, you will have the opportunity to champion our sources of truth as well as plan, lead and unify the cross channel delivery of test & learn agendas.
Sitting at the intersection of our media channel leads and our analytics specialists, you will ensure our Marketing Mix Models (MMM) are fed with the right data and that our Test & Learn ideas are translated into rigorous, actionable experiments. 
Main responsibilities
MMM Operations 
 As the primary point of contact for all data sharing and queries from MMM partners, you will manage a timely process of gathering, cleaning, and formatting media delivery and performance data for our econometric models.Accuracy & Quality Assurance: Ensuring all shared data is accurately formatted and reflects the reality of our media activity across all platforms. Performance Interpretation and storytelling: Assist in interpreting model results, helping to translate statistical outputs into a clear story focused on which channels are under-performing, and where the opportunity for growth lies.Agency partner: Maintain regular contact with our econometrics agency partners. In this position you will manage the flow of requests, ensure adherence to briefs, and interrogate recommendations where necessary. Internally you will champion their work and ensure engagement with the output.Evolution and innovation: To maximise the impact and effectiveness of our model, you will consider opportunities to further improve the data feed. By maintaining knowledge of industry best practice, and building a strong relationship with relevant contacts, you will have the opportunity to maximise the impact of MMM throughout the wider business.
 Experimentation rollout
In collaboration with channel managers, you will manage the measurement framework and experimentation roadmap. In which we will detail our test and learn priorities that you will spearhead as the year goes on.Learning Prioritisation: Own the rollout of the experimentation and measurement roadmap. Ensuring the tests deemed most important are executed in timely and rigorous manners.The "Knowledge Bank": Maintain the central test & learn log. Documenting every outcome, and sharing those with wider stakeholders to ensure that learnings are actively used to ameliorate media plans.Technical Translation: Collaborate with specialists and analysts to take ambitious ideas from Channel Leads (owned and paid), and translate them into technical briefs for specialists to build. Initiative Support: Design and set up cross-channel Test & Learn initiatives, including A/B testing, Meta/Google Lift studies, and regional Geo-tests across both owned and paid media.
Skills you’ll need (minimum criteria)
Have demonstrable experience within a media business. Either agency (Data/Analytics/Planning/ Transformation) or an in-house effectiveness operations role.Experience with both paid and owned media with an ability to evidence the nuances in their measurement challenges.Proven experience working across multiple media channels.Proven experience working with, Marketing Mix Modeling, Multi-Touch Attribution, and Incrementality Testing.Familiarity with the “plumbing” of measurement - how pixels, APIs and Clean Rooms function to collect data.Experience managing relationships with third-party measurement partners.
Other things we’re looking for (key criteria)
You will be detail orientated - That could manifest in being able to spot errors that others may overlook, or to ensure excellence in every data sheet you share. You are highly organised and capable of managing multiple work streams between different teams with competing deadlines.

rows.title: Senior Product Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Department: 61-446 - Technology - Product TechnologyLocation: UK - London

Description

Why DAZN?
DAZN brings live sport to millions of fans around the world the biggest leagues in football, boxing, motorsport, NFL, hundreds of competitions, every week. Our Product team plays a central role in deciding what we build, why, and in what order from a fan's first visit, through signing up and paying, to watching on match day and staying connected to their sport in between.

We're making DAZN the Home of Sports. A product that works flawlessly and gets to know each fan better every time they use it. We're doing it fast, and you'll help shape it for millions of people.


The role
As a Senior Product Manager you'll own a significant part of the DAZN experience and the outcomes that come with it. You'll be given a goal a customer pain point, a commercial target, a KPI to move and you'll find the opportunities and decide which ones matter. From there you'll work with Engineering and Design to build the solution, launch it, and use data to show whether it worked.

You'll work quickly and with a bias for action, alongside Engineering, Design and Commercial teams, bringing local customer needs together with DAZN's global product strategy. You'll also be a senior voice in the product team mentoring other PMs, setting the standard for how we work, and helping build the culture we want. You'll report to the lead of one of our outcome-led verticals.

What You'll Be Doing:

Owning an outcome, not just a feature: the discovery, definition and delivery of a wider area of the product, and the KPIs that tell us whether it's working.Identifying opportunities before anyone asks from data, customer research, commercial conversations and what's happening in the market and building the case for the ones worth doing.Turning goals into clear problems, and problems into requirements, prototypes and success measures your engineers and designers can act on.Using data, experiments, A/B tests and customer feedback to decide what to build and to prove what it delivered.Understanding the commercial side of your decisions subscribers, revenue, cost and explaining the trade-offs plainly to leadership.Keeping the whole customer journey in view, not just your area. A change in one place shows up somewhere else, and the fan only sees one DAZN.Working daily with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Marketing, Commercial, Legal, Customer Service and Operations, and representing the customer in those conversations.Building AI and personalisation into the product you own recommendations, content, journeys where it makes the experience better for the fan.Using AI in how you do the job, and showing other PMs how: prototyping before you write a ticket, analysing data, drafting specs and updates, testing assumptions faster. This is expected of every PM here, not a specialist AI role.


What You'll Bring:

Around 5 years in product management, ideally in streaming, consumer technology, media or e-commerce at scale.A track record of owning an area of a product and the outcomes behind it, not just delivering features.Experience finding and shaping opportunities yourself you don't need a problem handed to you.Comfortable with analytics, A/B testing and customer research you can find your own answers in the data.Already using AI tools day to day to prototype, analyse, write and test ideas and able to show us examples.Structured thinking and good judgement about priorities when everything looks important..Able to build working relationships quickly you'll work with a range of engineering and design teams, and getting the best out of each one is part of the job.Customer-focused and commercially minded, with the appetite to take ownership and help others do the same.Interest in sport helps, but caring about the customer matters more.


Benefits

Benefits include access to DAZN, 25 days’ annual leave (increasing by 3 days after 3 years), private medical insurance, life assurance, pension contributions up to 5%, family friendly community including enhanced parental leave, electric vehicle benefit option, learning and development resources, opportunity for flexible working, and access to our internal speaker series and events.

rows.descriptionText:
Description

At Audible, we believe stories have the power to transform lives. It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As Audible continues to revolutionize audio entertainment, we are seeking a strategic deal-maker to serve as the Director, Global English Publisher Partnerships, Deal Architecture and Enablement. This role drives deal success across Audible's third party publisher relationships, leading negotiations directly while architecting creative deal structures that deliver measurable business outcomes for the broader team.

You will own a portfolio of publisher relationships and negotiations for the Global English Publisher Partnerships organization, managing deals from initial discussions through execution. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global English Publisher Partnerships, you will negotiate commercial terms directly with publishers, develop deal structures, and collaborate with Finance, Legal, Product, and cross-functional teams to shape how Audible values and structures its third party publisher relationships. You will also enable the broader deal team by translating business performance insights into negotiation approaches and deal frameworks that advance the team's objectives.

You are a deal-maker with strong business acumen and financial modeling capabilities. You combine negotiation expertise with the ability to value complex deal structures and the communication skills to influence senior leadership and cross-functional partners. You're equally comfortable leading high-stakes negotiations, building deal valuation models, and presenting recommendations that drive investment decisions. You thrive in ambiguity, ask the right questions, and have a proven ability to close deals while elevating the capabilities of those around you. You have a passion for audio storytelling and digital media.

Partnerships, combining negotiation expertise with financial acumen and business judgment Champion efficiency within the Publisher Partnerships team through automation and AI tools, reducing manual Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText: Teamwork makes the stream work. Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.  What does the team work on?The Ad Partner Solutions (APS) team at Roku is the critical bridge between our advertising technology platform and the ecosystem of measurement, data, and attribution partners that power advertiser success. We enable seamless integrations with industry-leading partners, ensuring that Roku's advertising solutions deliver best-in-class measurement, audience targeting, and campaign optimization capabilities.Our team is responsible for the full lifecycle of partner integrations – from initial scoping and technical implementation through ongoing optimization and strategic expansion. We work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams to drive partner adoption, resolve technical challenges, and unlock new revenue opportunities through data and measurement partnerships. What is the role?We are seeking an Ad Partner Solutions Manager – Data & Measurement to own and scale our relationships with measurement, attribution, and data partners. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of technology, partnerships, and advertising, with a passion for solving complex integration challenges and driving measurable business impact. You will serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of strategic partners, managing the technical and operational aspects of integrations while identifying opportunities to deepen partnerships and expand Roku's measurement capabilities. Success in this role requires strong technical acumen, excellent communication skills, and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.For New York Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $139,900 - $157,800. Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location. This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off. How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment. What are the responsibilities of the role?Serve as the primary point of contact for Roku's portfolio of data and measurement partners spanning Identity, Measurement, Data Providers, Mobile Measurement, and Verification categoriesCollaborate with technical counterparts at partner organizations to ensure successful integrations and ongoing alignment with Roku's platform and ad productsManage the end-to-end integration lifecycle for new partners — from intake and scoping through testing, activation, and ongoing maintenance — partnering with Technical Operations, Ad Measurement, Product and Engineering to ensure integrations meet Roku's standardsMonitor the health of integrations across measurement data (attribution, lift studies, pixel/tag health) and partner data (match rates, sync latency, integration uptime, SLA compliance), proactively resolving issues before they impact advertiser campaign outcomesDiagnose and troubleshoot technical issues that may prevent Roku and its partners from maximizing the value of data and measurement partnershipsAdvocate for and collaborate with Product teams to build monitoring tools that detect partner disruptions and data outages before they escalateSupport partner QBRs and roadmap alignment sessions, helping ensure partner direction aligns with Roku's commercial goals and advertiser needsIdentify opportunities to deepen existing partnerships and evaluate new partner opportunities based on market demand, technical fit, and commercial viabilityDevelop and deliver enablement for Sales, Client Success, and Ad Ops teams — covering partner capabilities, workflows, escalation paths, and best practicesSynthesize complex data and measurement topics into clear business opportunities and challenges, adapted to the technical level of the audienceAssist in monitoring spend and performance of partner-driven initiativesDevelop a keen understanding of how the Roku platform and unique ad products deliver value to support data and measurement partner goals What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree a plusMinimum of 5 years of experience in a technical solutions, partner management, or measurement-focused role within the advertising or media industryStrong understanding of the advertising data and measurement landscape, including familiarity with identity solutions, campaign measurement and attribution, and ad verificationExperience managing partner integrations involving data feeds, measurement tags, APIs, cleanrooms, and cross-platform data sharing methodsFamiliarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including how data and measurement partners interact with demand-side and supply-side platformsAnalytical mindset comfortable interpreting data quality metrics and campaign performance data to inform decisions and drive proactive actionProven history of maintaining and growing critical, revenue-driving partner relationshipsAbility to take complicated subject matter and communicate clearly and effectively for any audience across all levels of the organizationSelf-starter with the operational rigor and strategic drive necessary to succeed in a highly competitive marketExperience working for/with premium streaming TV (CTV/OTT) publishers or platforms a plusFamiliarity with data privacy considerations and their impact on data sharing and measurement in advertising a plus What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com. What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

About This Opportunity

The Intelligent Customer Products (ICP) platform is a new CDO platform within Consumer Relationships. It builds and scales capabilities including Conversational AI, AI Search, CoachAI and Super Agent to deliver trusted, personalised and effortless AI-powered customer experiences. ICP helps Lloyds create proactive, intelligent customer interactions that drive growth, improve customer satisfaction and reduce cost to serve, underpinned by the standards, governance and operational foundations needed to deploy AI safely at enterprise scale.

The Senior AI Engineer role is a hands-on technical role within the Intelligent Customer Products (ICP) Platform, responsible for designing, building and supporting AI-powered customer experiences across Lloyds Banking Group. Working as part of multidisciplinary teams, the role contributes to the development, deployment and operation of machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI solutions that power strategic capabilities such as Conversational AI, AI Search and personalised customer engagement. The successful candidate will apply strong software engineering and AI expertise to deliver secure, scalable and responsible AI solutions to production.

What You’ll Be Doing

Design, develop, test and deploy LLM and agentic AI solutions Contribute to the development of LLM, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic AI solutions, including evaluation, optimisation and monitoring.Implement reliable and scalable AI solutions using established software engineering, MLOps and LLMOps practices.Contribute across the AI delivery lifecycle from experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment and operational support.Collaborate with platform engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise services and customer journeys.Support Responsible AI, model governance, monitoring, auditability and risk management requirements throughout the solution lifecycle.Investigate emerging AI technologies and contribute ideas for improving products, processes and engineering practices.Work closely with Product, AI Engineering, Architecture and Software Engineering colleagues to translate customer and business requirements into scalable technical solutions.Participate in code reviews, knowledge sharing and engineering communities to continuously improve team capability and technical quality.

Why join us?

We’re transforming at pace. Investing billions in our people, data and tech to change the way we meet the needs of our 28 million customers. We’re growing, and we’d love you to be part of the journey.

What we’re looking for?

Proven experience engineering technology solutions in complex environments and supporting production operations Applied AI/ML and GenAI experience with knowledge of established patterns (RAG, tool use, guardrails, evaluation, agents) and an ability to evaluate tools and approaches Experience working with conversational AI platforms and customer-facing AI applications. Experience working with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including exposure to services such as Vertex AI, BigQuery and Kubernetes.Understanding of CI/CD, version control and software delivery best practices.Ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams and contribute throughout the software development lifecycle.Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.Awareness of Responsible AI, model governance, security and operational considerations when deploying AI solutions.

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. Whilst this job advert may reference specific years of experience, we recognise that skills are developed in many ways, so if you have relevant, transferable experience, we encourage you to apply.

This is a place for you

Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.
