rows.title: Data Quality Executive
rows.descriptionText:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

Data Quality Executive

Location: Milton Keynes (Hybrid working, 2 days per week in the office. Tues/Weds)

Team: Customer Experience - Data Quality

Reports to: Data Quality Team Leader

The role

An exciting opportunity has emerged to join the Data Quality Team as a Data Quality Executive at the UK’s number one property portal. Our partners are at the heart of everything we do, which means that we want to make things easy and right for them first time, every time.

As a member of Rightmove’s Data Quality Team you’ll play an important part in ensuring what’s displayed on Rightmove is accurate, fair and never misleading. Specifically, your role will focus on being the first point of contact for partners and consumers, content moderation, triaging inbound queries, and referring cases for assessment by the Data Quality Advisors when appropriate.

This Role Will Include

Monitor, moderate, and upload advert content to ensure alignment with legislation and Rightmove’s Technical and Text Content Guidelines.Approve and verify reviews, ensuring authenticity and adherence to the DMCCA legislation.Track review similarity and duplication, identifying patterns and potential misuse.Triage and manage incoming queries, meeting SLAs and performance targets while escalating high-priority cases to Data Quality Advisors.Maintain proactive communication with the Data Quality Team Leader and Manager, flagging risks and requesting support when needed.Engage with consumers, and partners to request review amendments, additional evidence, or identification where necessary, ensuring all communication is clear, compliant and relevant.Act as first point of contact for sensitive or complex queries, resolving concerns with professionalism and empathy.Support continuous improvement, identifying process enhancements within the Data Quality team.Promote adoption of self-service tools and initiatives, encouraging partner engagement and providing clear guidance.

We’re Looking For Someone Who

Takes responsibility for their own workload, and for that of the team. You should be able to work under your own initiative and be self-motivating, determined to ensure the Data Quality inbox is always within our team targets.Is a great communicator. You’ll be happy to speak up when you’ve seen an area for improvement, or to raise a priority case to the Data Quality Team Leader or Manager.Is proactive and shares honestly and early. If you notice that inbound enquiries are increasing, you’ll bring it to the attention of the Data Quality Team Leader and arrange support to ensure we stay within our team targets.Has great knowledge of our Technical Guidelines, Text Content Guidelines, Terms and Conditions and relevant regulatory legislation showing sound judgement when assessing inbound queries.Is able to demonstrate understanding and empathy towards the people you speak to. Data Quality is an emotive subject, and it’s important we handle all queries sensitively, whilst working towards a prompt resolution.Has great prioritisation skills, is able to appreciate urgency and act accordingly.Has excellent relationship building skills, able to form relationships with partners and Rightmovers.Has good understanding of GDPR and ensures all forms of communication are compliant.Has exceptional written and verbal communication skills with high attention to detail.Is proficient in Microsoft office, particularly Outlook, Excel and Word.

About Rightmove

Our vision is to give everyone the belief that they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust and belief to make it happen.

We're home to the UK's largest choice of properties, and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what's on the market.

Despite This Growth, We’ve Remained a Friendly, Supportive Place To Work, With Employee #1 Still Working Here! We’ve Done This By Placing The Rightmove Hows At The Heart Of Everything We Do. These Are The Essential Values That Reflect Our Culture, And Include

We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.

rows.title: HR Operations & Payroll Senior Advisor
rows.descriptionText:
The HR Operations & Payroll Senior Advisor will play a key role in supporting the separation of BPL as it transitions to operating independently. Working as part of the HR team, the role will provide hands-on HR operational support to managers and colleagues throughout the separation, with a particular focus on HR administration, employee queries, HRIS transition, payroll and Day 1 readiness.

The HR Operations & Payroll Senior Advisor will be a key first point of contact for HR queries, providing timely and practical support while triaging more complex or specialist matters to the relevant HR Centres of Excellence (COEs).

This is an opportunity to join a business undergoing significant transformation and to play a key role in standing up new HR infrastructure and processes, including the transition from Workday to the new HRIS and supporting payroll through the separation and dual-run period.

Key Responsibilities


The key initial focus for this role is to support the wider HR team in delivering the separation programme and to provide hands-on support during periods of increased activity around Day 1, payroll transition and HRIS implementationEnsure HR data in the HRIS is accurate and easily reportableSupport managers and colleagues with day-to-day queries on how to use the HRIS and complete any system administration that is required Help establish robust and efficient HR processes for the standalone businessSupport testing and readiness activities ahead of key transition milestonesAct as a first point of contact for generalist manager and colleague HR queries across BPL, triaging more complex queries to the relevant HR COEProvide timely, accurate advice on HR policies, processes and employee lifecycle mattersIdentify recurring queries and process issues and use this to improve available guidanceAct as a key point of contact for payroll-related colleague and manager queriesAssist with payroll input, validation, reconciliationSupport key payroll activities including starters, leavers, changes to personal details, salary changes, bonuses and other employee data impacting payrollSupport the dual running of payroll during the transition to the new operating modelPrepare HR documentation and correspondence as requiredProduce regular HR reports and data to support the HR team and wider businessMaintain appropriate confidentiality and data protection standard when handling employee information


To be successful as a HR Operations & Payroll Senior Advisor, you will have experience with: 


Previous experience working in a HR Services and Payroll teamGood working knowledge of core HR processes and the employee lifecycleGood understanding of payroll processes and the ability to investigate payroll-related issuesExperience working with HRIS platforms; Workday experience is desirable for this first separation phaseStrong attention to detail, particularly when working with employee data and payrollComfortable working with spreadsheets, data validation and reconciliationExperience supporting an HRIS implementation would be advantageousComfortable working in a fast-paced, changing environment with competing priorities


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills

The successful candidate will be based in London. Our offices are located at 1 Churchill Place and 7 Westferry Circus (new BPL office). We support a hybrid working pattern with 3 days per week office-based presence expected.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients.

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments (BPL) brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years.

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield, please visit Barclays.com. 

Purpose of the role

To deliver HR services and support to Barclays colleagues, candidates, alumni and third-party vendors.

Accountabilities


Delivery and execution of HR operational activities aligned with people leader and colleague journeys aligned with bank policies and regulations, including performance management, rewards, benefits and learning operations documentation, coordination, and administration.On- and offboarding of new employees, (including orientation, documentation, coordination, exit interviews), knowledge transfer performance, rewards, learning operations and related administration.Maintenance of colleague personal and reference data in relevant HR information systems, ensuring data accuracy and compliance with data privacy regulations, reporting and analytics.Provision of guidance and support on candidate, colleague and alumni queries relating to HR policies, procedures, processes, or guidance.


Vice President Expectations


To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: Senior Enterprise Architect
rows.descriptionText:
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC, and fulfil your potential - whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Enterprise Architect.

CIB IT delivers technology that powers banking services for corporate, commercial and global banking clients, providing a comprehensive set of capabilities to meet clients’ needs worldwide. Within this, Credit and Capital Management is on a major global transformation programme, with significant investment to modernise platforms and deliver industry-leading solutions for customers and colleagues.

You’ll partner with business architects to translate target business processes and functions into functional components and the interactions between them, then work with solution architects and technical leads to shape delivery roadmaps and drive implementation and adoption. You’ll operate in a large, complex environment spanning legacy technologies from multiple eras, ensuring business-critical systems remain stable while new, modern components, built with open architecture, APIs and microservices, data/ML capabilities, and cloud where appropriate are introduced progressively to support Commercial Banking growth ambitions.

As an HSBC employee in the UK, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities and a competitive pay and benefits package. This includes private healthcare for all UK-based employees, enhanced maternity and adoption pay and support when you return to work, and a contributory pension scheme with a generous employer contribution.

In This Role You’ll

 Build a thorough understanding of existing and target business functions, processes and assets  Understand how current systems/components enable those capabilities, with particular focus on problem areas  Partner with Business Architects to translate target capabilities into functional components and clear functional boundaries  Drive technical realisation of functional components, working with Solution Architects and Technical Leads to map functional components into the right UI, processing, data, and messaging designs  Engage vendors to assess suitability (or otherwise) of potential vendor components  Work with business and programme management to define implementation/adoption roadmaps that maintain service continuity and realise benefits early  Provide business knowledge to Solution/Technical Architecture and Engineering teams, and legacy systems knowledge to Business/Solution/Technical Architects  Demonstrate leadership on Regulatory & Compliance; maintain awareness of operational risk and support identification, mitigation, control and reporting 

To be successful in this role you should meet the following requirements:

 Proficient Enterprise / solution architecture including design skills with ability to produce “fit for purpose solution designs” following best practices  Ability to build high-level proposals (e.g., Clear Choice) and clearly articulate pros/cons in business terms to enable sound decisions  Skilled in analysing requirements and translating business capability into functional components and architecture  Effective graphical, written and verbal communication for both technical and non-technical stakeholders  Experience using agile methods, understanding their limitations, and knowing how to overcome them in complex environments  Experience designing/implementing highly scalable, highly available cloud services (e.g., GCP/Azure)  Breadth across modern + legacy technology stacks such as Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, API gateways (Kong), REST, Kafka, React  Familiarity with large-scale transformation using analytics and AI/ML 

Opening up a world of opportunity

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic background or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please get in touch with our Recruitment Helpdesk via hsbc.recruitment@hsbc.com .

rows.title: Lead Product Owner
rows.descriptionText:
Join us as a Lead Product Owner

Use product, data, analytics, and technology to build capabilities that deliver better customer outcomes and prevent economic crimeSet the vision, strategy, and integrated roadmap for economic crime analytics products and platforms aligned to customer outcomes, regulatory commitments, and strategic prioritiesYou’ll be part of an environment that is passionate about your growth, fosters inclusion, and champions your potential for shared success

What you'll do

As the Lead Product Owner, you’ll set the product direction for our Economic Crime analytics capabilities. You’ll bring customer, colleague, and business needs to form a clear vision and prioritised roadmap for the bank. Moreover, you’ll lead a team of Product Owners and Business Analysts, creating the focus, decision-making, and ways-of-working needed to turn complex problems into measurable outcomes.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Leading, coaching, and developing a product function of Product Owners and Business Analysts, driving clear ownership and consistent standardsOwning end-to-end product outcomes, ensuring the implementation of proposed solutions and measuring the delivered impactShaping investment choices and sequencing across run and change, making clear trade-offs between customer value, fraud-loss prevention, risk, technical debt, cost, capacity and dependenciesWorking across teams to align product strategy and delivery, building scalable and sustainable capabilities

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for a strategic, outcome-focused product leader with experience in leading complex products, platforms, or portfolios in an agile environment. You’ll be comfortable setting direction and establish clarity across organisational boundaries. Moreover, you’ll hold teams accountable for measurable value, combining strong commercial judgement with excellent communication and people leadership skills.

In Addition, We’ll Expect You To Have

Strong knowledge of fraud and financial crime risk, as well as the technology needed to mitigate threats in a financial industry contextExperience in translating complex business problems into clear product strategies, roadmaps, outcomes, and prioritised backlogsStrong understanding of data, analytics, technology, and AI-enabled productsStrong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders effectively

rows.title: BPL Financial Crime Policy & Advisory AVP
rows.descriptionText:
We're seeking an experienced Financial Crime professional with Merchant Acquiring expertise to join our BPL Financial Crime Policy & Advisory team.

This is a Second Line of Defence role responsible for supporting the provision of Financial Crime oversight, advice and challenge across the Payments Acquiring business. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, Risk and Compliance teams, you will contribute to the effective management of financial crime risks whilst supporting the business in achieving its strategic objectives.

You will provide advisory support on complex Financial Crime matters, contribute to policy and governance activities, support risk assessments and remediation programmes, and help enhance the control environment across the merchant lifecycle.

This role requires a strong understanding of the Financial Crime risks associated with Merchant Acquiring, including customer onboarding, payment facilitators, marketplaces, high-risk merchant sectors, transaction flows, sanctions exposure, fraud typologies and evolving regulatory expectations.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop your Financial Crime expertise within a dynamic Merchant Acquiring environment. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of Financial Crime risks, work alongside experienced subject matter experts, and play an important role in strengthening the control environment that supports our merchant acquiring business.

You'll have the opportunity to influence risk outcomes, contribute to strategic initiatives and build specialist expertise in one of the fastest-evolving areas of financial services.

Key Accountabilities


Assist in providing Financial Crime advice and guidance to the Merchant Acquiring business on day-to-day risk matters, customer onboarding, customer lifecycle management and business initiatives.Support with the interpretation and implementation of Financial Crime policies, standards and regulatory requirements.Review customer escalations, high-risk merchant referrals, policy exceptions and risk assessments, providing clear and risk-based recommendations.Assist in the oversight of remediation programmes, audit actions and regulatory deliverables, ensuring actions are tracked and completed effectively.Perform analysis of Financial Crime metrics, incidents, emerging threats and industry developments to identify potential risks and control improvements.Support the development and enhancement of Financial Crime policies, procedures and risk management frameworks.Assistance in producing high-quality management information, analysis, briefing papers and governance materials for stakeholders and committees.Contribute to thematic reviews, deep dives and oversight activities to assess the effectiveness of Financial Crime controls.


To be successful as a Merchant Acquiring Financial Crime Policy & Advisory AVP, you should have:


Experience within Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk or a related control function within banking, payments or financial services.Merchant Acquiring experience preferred but string payments experience considered.Knowledge of AML, Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption and wider Financial Crime risk management principles.Experience analysing complex information, identifying risks and providing clear recommendations.Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced environment.Experience preparing management information, governance papers and risk reporting.Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and use of data analytics desired.


Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include


Ideally, experience working within a Second Line Financial Crime, Compliance or Risk team.Knowledge around card scheme requirements, payment facilitators, marketplaces and higher-risk merchant sectors preferred.Professional qualifications such as ICA, ACAMS or equivalent.Use of Data Analytics to interpret large quantities of data


You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role will be based in London or Northampton.

Barclays’ payments acceptance business provides critical infrastructure to the UK economy, processing billions of pounds of payments annually for both small businesses and domestic and international corporate clients. 

In April 2025, we announced a long-term partnership with Brookfield Asset Management to grow and transform the payments acceptance business by broadening the range of services offered, enhancing the experience for both existing and prospective clients. Leveraging extensive client relationships and deep experience of UK payments, we will create an environment of continuous innovation - activated by Brookfield’s global private equity expertise in payments, technology, operational transformation and corporate carve-outs - to ensure the business is strategically positioned for long-term growth.

Barclays will invest approximately £400m in the new business, the majority of which will be incurred during the first three years. Performance-linked incentives will drive greater alignment between the partners, underpinning the long-term commitment to the transformation. Barclays and Brookfield will work to create a standalone entity over time, continuing to use the Barclaycard Payments brand and acting as the sole payments acceptance services provider to Barclays’ clients for a minimum of ten years. 

For more information on our partnership with Brookfield (programme ‘Gaia’), please visit Barclays.com. 

Purpose of the role

To provide data-led expert oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organisation is operating in a compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities.

Accountabilities


Identification and assessment of compliance risks through thorough reviews of business activities, changes, processes, testing and systems to.Identification and investigation of potential market abuse, including but not limited to, Insider Dealing, Unlawful Disclosure, Market Manipulation or Anti-Competitive Conduct.Conduct investigation of compliance risk events or breaches. Oversight and check and challenge of corrective actions and preventative measures to avoid future occurrences.Implementation of compliance policies and procedures in line with regulatory requirements and ensuring that the bank’s internal policies are aligned with international standards, including jurisdictional requirements.Collaboration with 1LOD, other relevant Compliance teams and legal, and relevant risk management functions to facilitate a comprehensive approach to compliance and risk management.Identification, investigation and oversight of potential money laundering, terrorist financing or other financial crime.


Assistant Vice President Expectations


To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

rows.title: B2B Marketing Manager
rows.descriptionText:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market.

We’re looking for a B2B marketing all-rounder, with a particular love of product marketing.

"Join a fast-paced, collaborative marketing team where you'll lead high-impact campaigns, influence strategic priorities, and help drive the success of some of Rightmove's biggest growth opportunities for our partners." - Colleen, Hiring Manager

We're a B2B specialist team within the wider marketing team. We focus on a wide range of partners, including Estate and Lettings Agents, New Homes Developers, Commercial Property Agents, Overseas Agents and more. Our partners shouldn’t be confused with our buyers, tenants and sellers who we call consumers.

The work is varied and offers the opportunity to join our close-knit and hard-working marketing team.

This role supports key strategic growth areas across our Partner Marketing team. You'll work closely with product development and sales teams to go to market with new products, services and initiatives that help our partners get more from their Rightmove membership. You'll play an important role in shaping and delivering marketing activity that drives engagement, adoption, retention and commercial growth across multiple audiences and propositions.

Working closely with the Senior Marketing Manager to help set and execute the marketing strategy across key partner audiences, products and strategic business initiatives.Collaborating with our sales, product and commercial teams to deeply understand our partners’ needs. You’ll use that insight to build highly targeted product marketing plans including value propositions and positioning. Then, create, plan and execute pilot programmes seeing them through to Go to Market roll-out and retention plans – you’re a thinker and do-er.Developing compelling campaigns and communications that help partners understand, engage with and get maximum value from Rightmove's products, tools and services.Working with research and analytics teams to create and deliver your Go To Market plans. Insights will also play a role in delivering regular data and insights to our Account Managers and CX teams, as well as directly to our partners through various channels ranging from email to slide decks.Monitoring and analysing campaign performance, adjusting strategies and tactics as needed to achieve optimal results. You'll also track performance against both personal and team KPIs.Working with our CRM Team to create, plan, brief and QA ad-hoc and automated journeys across the customer lifecycle to help our partners make the best of all the benefits of Rightmove.Working with teams across marketing including our Creative Studio, research and insights, social, PR, consumer marketing, CRM and events to deliver on your plans, including planning across key platforms to optimise the partner experience, engagement and retention.Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business and act as a trusted marketing partner for the areas you support.

What a Marketing Manager in the B2B team thrives on: 

Owning multiple projects at one time, delivering in a fast-moving agile environment.Planning a project from end to end without breaking a sweat, easily dividing big goals into small steps, hitting deadlines, and driving commercial results.Insight-driven, questioning and budget-conscious, with an ability to meld all three together to deliver against objectives;Asking questions to uncover the true objective of projects to identify and deliver the right solution.Combining the creative with the analytical - digging deep into data and research insights to tell compelling stories about products, packages and the property market (and even things that don’t start with the letter p.)Working with people at all levels and across all teams – including Account Management, Product, Tech and our senior leadership team.Being a communications expert. You use simple language and brief messaging that shows you’ve gotten to know what matters to our partners and compels them to act. Strong writing skills are a must.Experimenting with AI and actively using it to make your work more efficient and effective.Demonstrating the impact you’ve made by measuring results and reporting on the key metrics for your campaigns. You’ll know what success looks like before you even start.Managing and influencing internal and external stakeholders.Developing a strong understanding of our industry, partners, and competitors. Even if you’ve not worked in the property space before, you can’t wait to get stuck in.

Our vision is to give everyone the belief that they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust and belief to make it happen.

We're home to the UK's largest choice of properties, and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what's on the market.

rows.title: Product Owner
rows.descriptionText:
Join Barclays as a Product Owner.

At Barclays, we're transforming the way we deliver products and experiences for our customers. As a Product Owner, you will play a critical role in maximising product value by defining a clear product vision and ensuring delivery teams focus on the work that matters most.

You will be responsible for authoring, refining and prioritising the product backlog, balancing customer desirability, business viability and technical feasibility to ensure the right solutions are built at the right time.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape innovative products that deliver lasting value for our customers and the organisation.

To be successful as a Product Owner, you should have experience with;


Proven experience translating product strategy into end-to-end persona journeys and user-centric experiences, using customer insights to define, prioritise and optimise product capabilities that drive adoption, engagement and measurable business outcomes. Experience applying design thinking, service design and customer journey mapping techniques to uncover user needs, identify pain points and create differentiated persona-based experiences.Advanced AI literacy with demonstrated day-to-day application of AI tools and capabilities. Candidates must be able to evidence how they leverage generative AI, copilots, automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve productivity, accelerate delivery, enhance decision-making, generate customer insights and improve product outcomes.Strong product leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across business, data, technology and control functions, navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and drive consensus in a complex enterprise environment.Strong Agile product delivery experience, with a proven track record of leading and operating within Agile teams. Deep understanding of Agile principles, product discovery, backlog management, prioritisation, iterative delivery, experimentation and continuous improvement is essential.


Some other highly valued skills may include;


Experience defining and measuring product adoption, customer experience and value realisation metrics, using data to continuously improve persona journeys and product outcomes.Deep expertise across modern data ecosystems, including metadata management, data lineage, data products, data modelling, data curation, APIs, analytics, event streaming, and data platforms operating across hybrid cloud and on-premise environments.Experience leading large-scale transformation initiatives, particularly the modernisation of legacy data platforms and the adoption of federated data products and self-service data capabilities.Agile certifications (e.g. SAFe, Scrum Product Owner, Scrum Master) and experience applying Agile practices at scale across cross-functional product and engineering teams.


You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills

This role will be based in Northampton

Purpose of the role

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities


Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.  Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully. Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog. Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy. Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience. Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value. Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives. Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals. Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.


Vice President Expectations


To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

rows.title: U.S Immigration Manager
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Uber Global Relocation & Immigration team is looking for a Manager to own the U.S. Immigration program from strategy through execution. In this role, you will define the strategic direction, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.

The U.S. immigration program is a critical enabler of Uber's talent strategy, supporting the hiring, retention, and mobility of foreign national employees while ensuring compliance with evolving U.S. immigration regulations.

The U.S. Immigration Manager will report directly to the Head of Global Relocation & Immigration and sit on the GRI leadership team. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, business leaders, immigration counsel, and external service providers to ensure Uber's immigration program effectively supports business objectives while delivering an exceptional stakeholder experience.

What The Candidate Will Do

 Own the strategy, governance, and execution of Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.  Lead end-to-end U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, L-1, O-1, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT, E-2, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Adjustment of Status, Consular Processing, and ongoing work authorization compliance requirements.  Serve as the primary strategic partner to Talent Acquisition, Legal, HR, and business leaders on immigration solutions, workforce planning, talent retention, and organizational growth.  Define and drive the U.S. immigration strategy, policies, governance frameworks, and program roadmap, identifying opportunities to improve scalability, compliance, stakeholder experience, efficiency, and business outcomes.  Own immigration vendor governance, including strategic relationship management, performance accountability, compliance oversight, commercial stewardship, and executive business reviews.  Own governance of U.S. immigration escalations, providing senior decision-making for high-risk, high-visibility, and complex immigration matters, while leveraging escalation trends and root cause insights to drive continuous program improvement.  Monitor regulatory developments and emerging immigration trends, assessing business impact and proactively advising stakeholders on readiness and risk mitigation strategies.  Define immigration program success metrics, compliance outcomes, vendor governance expectations, and strategic KPIs, using data and insights to drive continuous improvement and measurable business impact.  Leverage technology, automation, AI, and analytics to drive strategic improvements, optimize program performance, and shape the future-state immigration technology roadmap in partnership with the GRI Experience Program Manager.  Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle.  Prepare and deliver strategic recommendations, program insights, and performance updates to senior leadership.  Own the U.S. immigration budget, including forecasting, financial planning, vendor spend management, and budget-to-actual reviews.  Build and maintain strong partnerships with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, and business leaders, influencing decisions and positioning immigration as a strategic enabler of Uber's talent objectives.  Lead, coach, and develop the U.S. Immigration Specialist (L4), providing strategic direction, prioritization, performance management, and career development. 

 Basic Qualifications 

 8+ years of U.S. business immigration experience, demonstrating deep expertise in employment-based immigration laws, regulations, and compliance requirements.  5+ program management experience, with the ability to lead complex initiatives from strategy through execution.  5+ years operating in complex, matrixed organizations, partnering with Senior level stakeholders to drive strategic initiatives. 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Strong strategic thinking and decision-making capabilities, with a track record of developing scalable programs and delivering measurable business impact.  Experience managing external immigration vendors, including governance, performance management, commercial oversight, vendor selection, and contract management.  Strong analytical skills, with experience leveraging data, technology, and automation to improve program effectiveness and stakeholder experience.  Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions at all levels of the organization.  Passion for delivering exceptional employee and stakeholder experiences.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber Freight Marketplace is building the next generation of logistics technology by leveraging Uber's proven marketplace playbook to freight. As part of a small, high-impact team, you'll help bring expertise from Uber's mobility and delivery marketplaces into a rapidly evolving industry, developing pricing, matching, recommendation, and optimization systems that will disrupt the freight industry ($1T TAM). Uber Freight is at a very early stage, with just 0.4% of the pie now, and it's a rare opportunity to solve challenging marketplace problems with AI/ML and marketplace optimization while shaping how the freight industry transforms.

We are looking for a highly motivated Machine Learning Engineer to join Uber's Marketplace team to modernize the Uber Freight marketplace team. It is a fascinating area with challenges in predictive modeling, causal inference, constrained optimization, reinforcement learning, marketplace design, etc. The business is about to elevate and this role has a huge growing opportunity.

What You'll Do

This role requires end to end ownership for the ML models in UF marketplace (cost prediction, booking probability, demand elasticity, etc.). While your job is mostly about model development, you will work with backend engineers together to put them in production and make sure they work as expected.

Basic Qualifications

 6+ years of experience developing ML models to solve business problem.  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related fields.  Familiar with modern AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch). 

Preferred Qualifications

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

As a Senior Systems Engineer in our Autonomous Mobility & Delivery (AM&D) group, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of autonomous transportation at Uber.

You will be responsible for the safety of the technical frameworks that allow Uber to integrate seamlessly with various autonomous vehicle (AV) partners while developing our own internal autonomous offerings. This role sits at the intersection of cutting-edge robotics, safety-critical systems, and complex platform integration. This role is on Uber's Autonomous Mobility and Delivery Safety team and reports to the Senior Manager, Systems Engineering, Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Autonomous Mobility & Delivery.

What You Will Need / Bonus Points

---- What You Will Do ----

Define partner-agnostic solutions: Develop and standardize technical safety solutions and frameworks that expedite the go-to-market process for diverse autonomous vehicle tech providers and AV fleet operators on the Uber platform.Define safety requirements for Uber-built autonomous offerings: Lead the elicitation and documentation of high-level and detailed system safety requirements for Uber's proprietary autonomous technology and platform services.Develop V&V strategies: Design comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) strategies for both internal Uber solutions and the complex technical interactions between Uber's platform and external AV Partner systems to ensure solutions meet Uber's safety bar.Safety Risk Assessment: Lead technical safety risk assessments to ensure that all AV partner integrations meet Uber's rigorous safety and performance standards.Influence Strategic Decisions: Act as a technical subject matter expert to influence long-term product roadmaps and strategic partnerships, ensuring technical feasibility and safety are at the forefront of business decisions.

Apply AI responsibly: Evaluate and integrate AI/ML-driven approaches to enhance safety validation and risk identification, while ensuring appropriate oversight, traceability, and compliance with safety standards.

 Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.7+ years of experience in systems engineering, with a significant focus on complex hardware/software integrations.Proven track record in the Autonomous Vehicle industry, specifically within safety-critical systems.Experience with V&V methodologies (e.g., ISO 26262, SOTIF/ISO 21448).

 Preferred Qualifications

Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant engineering discipline.Experience defining cross-functional system architectures for large-scale distributed systems.Strong ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.Experience leveraging AI/ML tools in engineering workflows or safety analysis

rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

Uber's Paid Marketing team helps drive growth for millions of customers and earners around the world. We're looking for a senior performance marketing strategist to lead paid marketing strategy for Delivery in our largest mega-region, the Americas.

In this role, you'll sit at the intersection of business strategy, analytics, and paid media. You'll identify the biggest growth opportunities for Delivery, determine where Paid can have the greatest impact, and shape how we invest across markets and channels.

You'll partner with regional Delivery leaders, global channel teams, Science, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to turn complex business problems into clear strategies and investment decisions.  Lead Paid Marketing Strategy 

 Translate Delivery business priorities into cross-channel paid growth strategies across the Americas.  Determine where and how Paid should invest across markets, channels, audiences, and initiatives.  Identify, test, and scale new approaches to drive incremental Delivery growth.

 Analyze performance and business trends to identify opportunities, risks, and root causes.  Use paid marketing fundamentals, acquisition economics, and measurement insights to evaluate investment tradeoffs.  Turn complex analysis into clear recommendations and decisions for senior stakeholders.

 Experience developing multi-channel paid marketing or growth strategies.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, form hypotheses, analyze data, and make investment recommendations. rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

As an Application Developer II (IAM Operations Engineer), you will take ownership of maintaining, scaling, and enhancing our enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) environment to deliver robust, seamless access controls. We are seeking a security-focused professional who thrives on bringing structure to complex systems and partnering closely with cross-functional technical teams to address critical infrastructure needs. In this role, you will lead end-to-end IAM workflows and system integrations, apply strong hands-on coding and architectural design principles, and drive strategic operational planning. The ideal candidate possesses in-depth experience with identity governance frameworks, authentication protocols, and core access control standards.

What You'll Do

 Identity Lifecycle Management: Own provisioning, de-provisioning, and access control workflows across enterprise systems.  Security & Access Controls: Implement and administer RBAC, Least Privilege, JIT, SSO, MFA, and PAM solutions.  Incident Resolution: Investigate IAM security incidents, perform root cause analysis, and drive platform improvements.  Compliance & Governance: Ensure alignment with SOX, GDPR, and HIPAA through regular audits, control validations, and access reviews.  Platform Administration: Configure cloud and enterprise platforms including Active Directory, Okta, SailPoint, Entra ID, Duo, CyberArk, AWS, and GCP.  Automation & Integration: Develop maintainable Python and PowerShell automation and API integrations to streamline IAM workflows.  Architecture & Planning: Translate complex requirements into practical technical designs and execution roadmaps.  Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Security, IT, and Compliance teams to manage risks and deliver key dependencies.  AI & Analytics Integration: Leverage AI tools to optimize support workflows, generate metrics, and identify security trends. 

Basic Qualifications

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field. Or equivalent experience.  5+ years of experience in IAM operations with proven ownership of enterprise production systems and integrations.  Proficiency in Python or PowerShell for developing production-ready IAM automation and API integrations.  Hands-on expertise with IAM protocols (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, LDAP), directory services, and major platforms (e.g., Okta, SailPoint, Entra ID).  Strong system design, technical planning, and troubleshooting skills across complex, multi-platform environments.  Experience with compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, HIPAA, GDPR, SOX) and cross-functional collaboration. 

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with Zero Trust security models and AI-driven identity analytics.  Knowledge of Cloud IAM (AWS IAM, Azure AD, Google Cloud IAM) and AI-enhanced cloud security.  Hands-on experience with IAM automation platforms, AI-based fraud detection, and anomaly detection.  Familiarity with DevSecOps and AI-driven IAM orchestration strategies.

About The Role

The Uber Global Relocation & Immigration team is looking for a Manager to own the U.S. Immigration program from strategy through execution. In this role, you will define the strategic direction, governance framework, and long-term roadmap for Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.

The U.S. immigration program is a critical enabler of Uber's talent strategy, supporting the hiring, retention, and mobility of foreign national employees while ensuring compliance with evolving U.S. immigration regulations.

The U.S. Immigration Manager will report directly to the Head of Global Relocation & Immigration and sit on the GRI leadership team. You will partner closely with Talent Acquisition, People & Places, Legal, Finance, business leaders, immigration counsel, and external service providers to ensure Uber's immigration program effectively supports business objectives while delivering an exceptional stakeholder experience.

 Own the strategy, governance, and execution of Uber's U.S. immigration program, ensuring compliance, operational excellence, and alignment with Talent Acquisition and People & Places priorities.  Lead end-to-end U.S. immigration programs, including H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, L-1, O-1, F-1 OPT/STEM OPT, E-2, PERM labor certification, I-140 petitions, Adjustment of Status, Consular Processing, and ongoing work authorization compliance requirements. Lead cross-functional initiatives that enhance immigration programs and deliver measurable business impact across the employee lifecycle. rows.title: Sr TA Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About The Role

The Talent Acquisition (TA) Analytics team's goal is to transform recruiting from a reactive function into a proactive, predictive powerhouse. A successful candidate is a strategic thinker who is flexible with shifting project priorities and thrives in a fast-paced environment. You demonstrate the confidence to tackle complex, ambiguous problems and the ability to partner effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders.

We seek a highly motivated, energetic self-starter to work directly with TA leadership. Your mission is to ensure they have the data, predictive models, and insights necessary to make informed decisions-often guiding them toward what they need to know, rather than just what they are asking for. You will proactively identify opportunities to enhance data quality, evaluate new recruiting technologies, and unlock insights that shape how we build our teams.

Responsibilities

 Predictive Analytics & Modeling: Utilize Python or R to build predictive models that forecast pipeline health, candidate conversion, time-to-fill, and long-term candidate quality.  AI & Tool Evaluation: Act as the analytical gatekeeper for our recruiting tech stack. Evaluate the ROI, efficacy, and potential bias of new AI tools and automated recruiting workflows.  Strategic Metric Definition: Drive the analytics strategy for modern TA disciplines. Define and track complex metrics such as Quality of Hire (QoH), skills-based hiring efficacy, and internal talent mobility.  Analytics Engineering & Modeling: Perform robust data modeling, transforming raw system data into structured models for visualization. Consult directly with data warehouse engineers to improve system integrations and data pipelines.  Data Visualization Strategy: Lead our visualization and reporting ecosystem. Design intuitive dashboards from scratch and apply advanced design tactics across various BI tools, shifting stakeholders from looking at descriptive data (what happened) to prescriptive insights (what to do next).  Ad-Hoc Consulting: Support complex, ad-hoc analytics requests from partners within TA and the broader People Organization. 

REQUIREMENTS

 BS/MS in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or another highly quantitative discipline.  Minimum 3 years of work experience in data analysis, data science, analytics engineering, or similar technical roles.  Proficiency in data manipulation and statistical modeling using Python or R.  Advanced SQL skills and exposure to modern data stores/querying frameworks (MySQL, BigQuery).  Proficiency with analytics engineering workflows and version control platforms (Dataform, dbt, GitHub).  Strong proficiency with enterprise data visualization tools (e.g. Looker, Power BI, Tableau) and a deep understanding of dashboard design, visualization strategy, and data storytelling tactics. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 Cross-Industry Perspective: Proven ability to dive into new data domains and learn them quickly. Note: Prior HR or TA analytics experience is not required; candidates bringing analytical best practices from outside the People space are highly encouraged to apply.  Experience auditing AI/machine learning tools for fairness/bias or assessing software vendor ROI.  Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).  Exceptional data storytelling skills: the ability to convey complex technical or statistical concepts to non-technical business leaders clearly and persuasively.  Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities with a tenacious commitment to finding the root cause of data discrepancies.  Comfortable taking absolute ownership of projects from requirements gathering to final deployment.

About The Role

Uber Freight Marketplace is building the next generation of logistics technology by leveraging Uber's proven marketplace playbook to freight.  Lead the collection, consolidation, and validation of performance data from international co-brand partners, ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of reporting across multiple markets and products. Be part of an amazing story.

Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. A story about innovations and traditions…about inspiring stores and irresistible products…about the excitement of the Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks, and the wonder of the Thanksgiving Day Parade. Job Overview

The Manager, Loyalty & Personalized Offers supports the execution of Macy’s external loyalty partnership strategy and manages internal stakeholder relationships to drive member engagement through targeted lifecycle offers. This role requires expertise in campaign management, omnichannel marketing, and partnership development and is ideal for a marketing professional who thrives in a high-performance, results-driven retail environment. The Manager collaborates closely with internal and external marketing partners to develop and execute strategies that enhance loyalty program value, strengthen customer engagement, and support business objectives.

In addition to the essential duties mentioned above, other duties may be assigned.

Skills You Will Need

Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing: Expertise in developing and executing loyalty, retention, and customer engagement strategies that drive member growth and lifetime value.

Partnership Management: Ability to identify, develop, and manage strategic partnerships that enhance customer value and support business objectives.

Campaign Management: Strong experience leading omnichannel marketing campaigns from strategy and offer development through execution and optimization.

Strategic Thinking & Innovation: Ability to develop go-to-market strategies, roadmap initiatives, and test-and-learn programs that drive business results and continuous improvement.

Data Analysis & Performance Measurement: Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure campaign effectiveness, interpret performance data, and deliver actionable insights.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to influence and align stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Merchandising, Technology, and external partners to achieve shared goals.

Communication & Relationship Building: Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build strong relationships and effectively communicate strategies, results, and recommendations.

Customer-Centric Marketing: Strong understanding of personalization, customer experience, and omnichannel engagement strategies that strengthen loyalty and brand affinity.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 3-5 years of related experience. This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

Access the full menu of benefits offerings here.

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.

rows.title: Associate Director, Telehealth Business Operations
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Associate Director, Telehealth Business Operations

Role Overview

Virtual Veterinary Services is building new ways for pet parents to access convenient veterinary care and support through Chewy. The business spans a growing portfolio of virtual care services—from triage and advice to full telemedicine—as well as services that help customers overcome prescription-related barriers when purchasing prescription medications and veterinary diets.

As Associate Director, Telehealth Business Operations, you will lead the business operations function for Virtual Veterinary Services and serve as a key partner to the General Manager in managing and scaling the business. You will build and run the mechanisms through which we understand business performance, develop operating plans and forecasts, evaluate growth opportunities, align customer demand with veterinary capacity, and translate business insights into action.

You will partner closely with Product, Analytics, Finance, Medical, Provider Operations, Workforce Management, Marketing, Category Management, and other Chewy teams. The ideal candidate combines strong business judgment and analytical curiosity with exceptional execution: digging deeply into data, developing a point of view from imperfect information, and working across teams to turn insights into results. They are energized by making teams and businesses work better—creating shared understanding, bringing structure to ambiguity, and helping cross-functional partners align around what matters most and act on it.

What You'll Own

Business Performance Management

Develop and maintain the performance framework across the portfolio, connecting financial, customer, product, operational, and provider metrics. Lead weekly and monthly business reviews, identifying what is working, what needs to change, and the underlying drivers, and ensuring insights translate into clear actions and accountability. Develop a deep understanding of performance by service, customer use case, entry point, product category, and other relevant dimensions. Partner with Analytics and Finance to understand performance against plan, diagnose meaningful variances, and connect veterinary service activity to downstream customer behavior and purchasing outcomes. Identify opportunities to improve growth, unit economics, customer experience, and operational efficiency and develop recommendations for action. 

Business Planning & Forecasting

Partner with the GM and Finance to translate business strategy and financial goals into operating plans and forecasts. Build and maintain models connecting customer demand, marketing activity, conversion, provider capacity, service levels, revenue, downstream sales, and cost. Coordinate inputs across Marketing, Product, Workforce Management, Provider Operations, Finance, and other teams to maintain an integrated view of expected business performance. Understand the assumptions underlying the financial plan and develop scenarios and recommendations as performance, capacity, investment, or other assumptions change. Support annual and long-range planning by translating strategic choices into operating assumptions and resource requirements. 

The GM retains accountability for the P&L, financial commitments, and major investment decisions; this role provides the analysis, planning, and understanding of business drivers needed to inform those decisions.

Growth & Business Optimization

Develop and manage the operating plan for growth across services, customer entry points, and use cases. Analyze customer funnels and downstream purchasing behavior to identify opportunities across acquisition, conversion, engagement, and repeat usage. Evaluate both demand generation opportunities that introduce customers to virtual veterinary care and demand capture opportunities that use veterinary services to resolve friction in an existing purchase journey. Partner with Marketing to understand the relationship between investment, incremental demand, provider capacity, and business returns. Partner with Product, Category Management, and customer-experience surface owners to evaluate opportunities to integrate virtual veterinary services into relevant Chewy customer journeys and assess their potential business impact. Identify differences in economics and customer value across consultation types, prescription categories, products, and use cases. Lead structured analysis of ambiguous business questions and opportunities, developing fact-based recommendations that consider customer value, growth, economics, operational feasibility, provider capacity, and strategic fit. Translate approved recommendations into executable cross-functional plans with clear ownership, milestones, and measures of success. 

Integrated Business Planning: Demand & Capacity

Develop and maintain the business-level demand forecast, incorporating growth plans, marketing activity, product changes, seasonality, and other key demand drivers. Partner with Workforce Management and Provider Operations to incorporate capacity requirements, constraints, utilization, availability, service levels, and cost into business plans and forecasts. Identify emerging supply-demand imbalances and assess their potential impact on growth, customer experience, provider experience, and financial performance. People are at the center of everything we do. The People Technology Solutions team provides the enabling technology foundation for candidate and employee experience at eBay. You will define product priorities and deliver solutions that help employees and leaders find, access, and engage with learning and development opportunities.

Workday Learning serves as a core platform for this role, though the scope goes beyond Workday configuration. The successful candidate will approach the learning ecosystem end-to-end, covering coordinated learning tools, content platforms, skills data, reporting, user experience, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities. This person will assist in translating learning strategy into scalable technology solutions, boost the employee and manager experience, and consistently refine how learning is delivered and assessed at eBay.

Skills You Will Need

Media Planning Strategy: Deep expertise in developing integrated media strategies across onsite and offsite channels that align advertiser objectives, audience insights, and performance KPIs to deliver strong campaign results.

Yield Management: Proven ability to optimize advertising inventory, fill rates, CPMs, and overall revenue through data-driven yield management strategies and inventory allocation decisions.

Analytical Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data, generate actionable insights, and make informed business recommendations.

People Leadership: Proven success leading, developing, and coaching high-performing teams, while fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous growth.

Cross-Functional Influence: Ability to partner effectively with Sales, Ad Operations, Advertising Operations, Analytics, and other stakeholders to align strategies and drive business results.

Strategic Thinking: Ability to translate business objectives, advertiser needs, and market dynamics into scalable media, audience, and revenue strategies.

Sales Partnership: Experience serving as a trusted advisor to sales teams by providing strategic guidance, audience insights, and media recommendations that strengthen client proposals and drive revenue growth.

Relationship Management: Proven ability to build credibility and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners while influencing decisions across multiple levels of the organization.

Project & Process Management: Ability to establish scalable processes, manage competing priorities, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.

Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex media, audience, and revenue concepts to diverse audiences.

Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, along with experience using advertising platforms such as GAM, DV360, Meta, Nielsen, Comscore, and CRM tools such as Salesforce.

Problem Solving: Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, navigate ambiguity, and develop practical solutions that balance advertiser needs, operational requirements, and business goals.

Execution Excellence: Strong attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence, ensuring media plans, forecasts, pricing strategies, and campaigns are executed accurately and effectively.

Who You Are

Candidates with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in a related field are encouraged to apply. 8-10 years of Media Planning experience within a digital media environment. 2-3 years of experience in Yield Management. This role involves performing essential job functions such as communication, collaboration, and use of office and computer systems. Responsibilities include the ability to access and review written and electronic information, and to move within the work environment and interact with workplace materials as needed to carry out job responsibilities.Able to work a flexible schedule based on department and company needs.

What We Can Offer You

Join a team where work is as rewarding as it is fun! We offer a dynamic, inclusive environment with competitive pay and benefits. Enjoy comprehensive health and wellness coverage and a 401(k) match to invest in your future. Prioritize your well-being with paid time off and eight paid holidays. Grow your career with continuous learning and leadership development. Plus, build community by joining one of our Colleague Resource Groups and make a difference through our volunteer opportunities.

Merchandise discountsPerformance-based incentivesAnnual merit reviewEmployee Assistance Program with mental health counseling and legal/financial adviceTuition reimbursement

About Us

This is a great time to join Macy’s! Whether you’re helping a customer find the perfect gift, streamlining operations in one of our distribution centers, enhancing our online shopping experience, buying in-style and on-trend merchandise to outfit our customers, or designing a balloon for the Thanksgiving Day Parade, we offer unique opportunities to be part of some of the most memorable moments in people’s lives.
